# UX/ UI Middle

Aplica aquí  
Si para ti el diseño no es solo pintar pantallas bonitas, sino crear sistemas escalables, testear la usabilidad con usuarios reales y clavar la bajada visual en un *pitch* comercial, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM buscamos a un/a UX/UI Designer (perfil *Middle*) para potenciar nuestra área creativa. Queremos a alguien que combine un criterio estético impecable con una solvencia técnica absoluta en el diseño de interfaces centradas en el usuario.

Buscamos a alguien acostumbrado/a al ritmo de agencia, que sea capaz de brillar en la fase de preventa, de trabajar mano a mano con Marketing y Desarrollo, y que garantice un delivery técnico perfecto para evitar cuellos de botella.

Tu misión es ser el motor creativo y funcional de nuestros proyectos digitales. Tu objetivo será elevar la calidad visual de nuestras propuestas, asegurar la usabilidad mediante metodologías centradas en el usuario, y crear productos digitales orientados a la conversión y alineados con el negocio.

Lo que harás en tu día a día:

UX/UI y Diseño Centrado en Usuario/a:

* Crear wireframes, prototipos y diseños visuales de alta fidelidad para aplicaciones web y móviles, asegurando siempre la coherencia y usabilidad (Mobile-First).  
* Aplicar metodologías centradas en el usuario (User-Centered Design) durante todo el proceso.  
* Liderar el proceso de investigación tanto en fase de descubrimiento (entrevistas, desk research, benchmark) como en fase de validación (tests de usabilidad, feedback real), asegurando que el diseño responda a problemas reales. Traduciendo los hallazgos de la investigación en artefactos accionables (User Persona, Customer Journeys, mapas de arquitectura) que guíen la conceptualización del producto.  
* Definir la arquitectura de la información, aplicar patrones de interacción sólidos y garantizar la accesibilidad web (WCAG).

Figma, Sistemas y Sinergia Técnica

* Trabajar con Figma a nivel experto: creación y evolución de Sistemas de Diseño, componentes complejos, variantes y Auto-layout.  
* Documentar especificaciones y guías de estilo rigurosas para mantener la consistencia visual en todos los proyectos.  
* Colaborar de tú a tú con los desarrolladores frontend y backend para validar la factibilidad técnica de los diseños y preparar un developer hand-off impecable.

Negocio, Marketing y Preventa

* Trabajar junto a los equipos de producto y marketing para asegurar que cada diseño esté 100% alineado con los objetivos comerciales.  
* Traducir las necesidades del cliente en propuestas visuales atractivas, aportando tu visión en los *pitches* comerciales y preventas.  
* Participar activamente en las reuniones de equipo para aportar ideas, soluciones creativas y mantenernos siempre actualizados sobre las últimas tendencias e innovaciones en UX/UI.

Crecemos contigo, cuidamos de ti:

* Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.  
* Modelo híbrido: Nos gusta vernos 1-2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.  
* Rango salarial: Entre 24K \- 34K€ brutos anuales, dependiendo de la experiencia.  
* Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.  
* Plan de Igualdad: Impulsamos la participación equitativa, el respeto y oportunidades justas para todas las personas.  
* Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.  
* Desarrollo profesional: Plan de desarrollo adaptado a tu perfil e inquietudes.  
* Jornada intensiva: Viernes hasta las 15:00h. Además en verano (desde el 22/06 hasta el 11/09) y navidad (21/12 hasta el 8/01) trabajamos en horario reducido de 8.00 a 15.00.

Imprescindible (si no lo tienes, no es tu rol):

* Experiencia en la trinchera: Lo ideal son entre 3 y 4 años de experiencia como UX/UI Designer o Art Director Digital, pero podemos valorar un rango de experiencia distinto. Eso sí, siempre que hayas estado trabajando y estés habituado/a al ritmo de entornos de agencias de publicidad, estudios de diseño o consultoras tecnológicas.  
* Portfolio Digital Obligatorio: Si no hay portfolio, hay descarte. Necesitamos ver casos reales de interfaces web, producto y *mobile-first*.  
* Figma experto: Tienes que dominar los Sistemas de Diseño, Auto-layout avanzado, creación de guías de estilo y el traspaso a desarrollo.  
* Bases Técnicas y Colaborativas: Experiencia demostrable trabajando con equipos técnicos (Frontend/Backend) para validar la viabilidad de tus diseños.  
* Habilidades y Mindset: Capacidad de trabajar en entornos rápidos, orientación a negocio y experiencia real en metodologías *User-Centered*.  
* Inglés medio.

Puntos extra:

* Vibe Coding & IA: Sabes apoyarte en LLMs (como Claude) y herramientas asistidas por IA para generar prototipos funcionales directos a código (*code-based prototyping*) y agilizar entregas en preventa.  
* No-Code: Te manejas con Framer o Webflow y puedes trasladar de manera autónoma un diseño de Figma a una web real.  
* Motion & Microinteracciones: Tienes experiencia con ProtoPie, After Effects o Spline para dar vida a las interfaces.  
* Cultura CRO y Datos: Entiendes de mapas de calor (Hotjar/Clarity), métricas de negocio y diseñas basándote en la optimización de la conversión.

Departamento  
Creativity & Content to Impact  
Puesto  
Creatividad y arte (Creatividad y Diseño gráfico)  
Ubicaciones  
Madrid  
Estado remoto  
Híbrido

## About the job

About the role  
We're seeking a EU-based Product Designer with a growth focus to help more people access the right support for their ADHD. You'll combine solid design instincts with data-driven optimization to scale our impact.  
Inflow was recently acquired by Cerebral, one of the largest digital mental health providers in the US. This opens up a broader range of support we can offer our users, from self-guided learning in the Inflow app to professional therapy via Cerebral, or a combination of both.  
A big part of this role is designing the experience that helps users find the right path for them.  
You'll work closely with Product and Engineering to run experiments and ship improvements across the full user journey, from how users discover and choose the right support, through to activation and long-term engagement.  
This role is hands-on and AI-native. You'll use modern AI tools to go from idea to working prototype fast and sometimes what you build will be close enough to ship. We're looking for someone who sees AI as a force multiplier for design velocity.   
You'll own the design process end-to-end: discovery, ideation, solution design, high-fidelity execution, and iteration.  
Balancing fast experimentation with thoughtful solutions, you'll work across the full spectrum of growth — from how users discover us, to how they convert, engage, and stay. We're a small team so you'll have real ownership and direct impact.   
What you'll do

* Own end-to-end design across growth surfaces — from research and ideation through high-fidelity implementation and continuous optimization  
* Design and optimize key growth surfaces. Funnels, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals and more, across web and app  
* Go from idea to working prototype fast using AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) — sometimes close enough to ship  
* Develop and validate design hypotheses through A/B testing and quantitative data  
* Conduct user research to inform design decisions and uncover opportunities  
* Balance rapid experimentation with thoughtful solutions, knowing when to iterate quickly vs. invest in deeper exploration

What we're looking for

* 3+ years of B2C product design experience — consumer apps, e-commerce, or subscription products, with proven impact on business metrics.  
* You're particularly strong in at least one area that matters to us, whether that's conversion design, building with AI, compelling UX storytelling, or running experiments that move metrics  
* Growth experience with hands-on work in at least two areas: CRO, onboarding, activation, monetization, retention, referrals, checkout, or AOV optimisation  
* Already building with AI (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as a natural part of your design workflow  
* Comfortable with A/B testing and data-informed design decisions — you don't need to be a data scientist, but you need to understand that experiments drive priorities in this role  
* Strong portfolio demonstrating design process and measurable outcomes  
* Good design instincts around user psychology and behavior  
* Comfortable with ambiguity, fast pace, and working in a small team with real ownership

Nice-to-haves

* Background in mental health or healthcare products

### Web and Digital Experience Lead

Marketing \- Spain (Remote)  
---

**Title:** Web and Digital Experience Lead      
**Target location:** Europe (Spain or UK)

**Moodle with us\!**  
At Moodle, we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. As the world’s most customisable and trusted open-source LMS, we partner with schools, universities, and organisations to create better learning experiences for millions. If you’re ready to make a real impact,  and be part of a global movement shaping the future of learning, join us let’s transform education together\!

**About the Role**  
The Web and Digital Experience Lead owns Moodle’s web ecosystem as a core growth channel, responsible for its strategy, performance, and continuous optimisation.  
This role ensures the website delivers high-performing, end-to-end user experiences that support campaign effectiveness, drive conversion, and scale with the business. Acting as the bridge between marketing and development, you will translate strategy into execution while maintaining strong technical oversight and the ability to deliver lightweight front-end changes directly.  
By combining strategic leadership with practical technical capability, this role reduces dependency on external agencies and ensures the website remains fast, effective, and built for long-term scalability.

**What You’ll Do**

Most days in this role usually involve a mix of:

* Own and maintain a prioritised web roadmap aligned to marketing and business goals, balancing campaign needs, optimisation opportunities, and foundational improvements  
* Own end-to-end user journeys from entry point through conversion, identifying friction and opportunities for improvement  
* Develop and execute a continuous optimisation and experimentation roadmap including A/B testing, landing page improvements, and conversion flows  
* Partner with demand generation and solutions marketing to translate campaign strategy into effective, high-performing web experiences  
* Define and track web success metrics beyond traffic, including conversion performance, engagement quality, and contribution to pipeline  
* Monitor and analyse web analytics KPIs, translating data into clear insights and actionable recommendations  
* Act as a steward of information architecture, UX consistency, accessibility, and performance across all web properties  
* Execute light front-end changes independently (content updates, layout adjustments, basic styling, simple scripts) to reduce reliance on external agencies  
* Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure seamless integration between the website and CRM/marketing systems including HubSpot  
* Manage and evaluate external web development agencies, leading the transition to more scalable, in-house processes  
* Report on website and digital experience performance, linking insights to business outcomes

**We’d love to meet you**

Especially if you can tell us about your:

* Demonstrated experience owning and optimising website performance and digital user journeys  
* Strong understanding of CRO, UX principles, and user journey design  
* Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and reporting platforms  
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with ability to make front-end updates confidently  
* Experience managing web roadmaps and prioritising across multiple stakeholders  
* Experience working with HubSpot and marketing operations teams  
* Familiarity with SEO principles integrated into broader digital strategy  
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills  
* High levels of autonomy, ownership, and accountability  
* Experience in B2B SaaS or EdTech (desirable)

**What's in it for you?**

Moodle has a globally diverse team with over 280 team members in more than 25 countries around the world. We’ve built a passionate team of hard-working, driven and diverse people from all over the world, united by a shared belief in the ability of our platform to make a positive difference to our world. We respect our colleagues and value an open and innovative workplace, filled with integrity and of course a strong focus on education (yes, these are our company values\!)

In addition to this you can expect:

* Taking on a genuinely flexible, distributed role, working from anywhere in the world  
* A fantastic range of benefits, focusing on work-life balance, wellbeing and ‘choosing your own adventure.’  
* Working with a global team on a worldwide platform and make a real difference.  
* As a certified B Corp, we are proud to be part of a global community of mission-driven companies dedicated to using business as a force for good.

**Learn more about Moodle**  
Moodle is the world’s most trusted online learning solution, with a growing ecosystem of products and services, including Moodle Workplace, Moodle App, MoodleCloud, and more. The engine of our ecosystem is Moodle LMS, the secure and customisable open source learning management platform used by well over 300 million learners worldwide.   
Find out more about us on our [website.](https://moodle.com/)  
*At Moodle we are an equal opportunity employer that actively supports diversity and inclusion in the workplace and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to fair recruitment and selection practices, ensuring we are drawing from a diverse range of sources to attract and select the very best person for the job. Learn more in our Diversity & Inclusion Charter.*

## About the job

En una compañía en plena evolución digital, buscamos incorporar un/a Senior Product Designer con visión estratégica y fuerte orientación a impacto en negocio. Formarás parte de un entorno multidisciplinar, colaborando con equipos de producto, tecnología y stakeholders clave para diseñar experiencias digitales end-to-end que generen valor real para el usuario.  
Si te motiva influir en decisiones de producto más allá del diseño, trabajar con datos y liderar experiencias complejas desde una perspectiva holística, este reto es para ti.  
🎯 Misión del puesto  
Como Senior Product Designer, tu misión será liderar la definición y evolución de experiencias digitales end-to-end, actuando como partner estratégico dentro del equipo de producto. Serás responsable de asegurar que las soluciones diseñadas no solo sean usables y consistentes, sino que impacten directamente en métricas clave de negocio y experiencia de usuario.  
🧩 Funciones

* Colaborar estrechamente con Product, Engineering y stakeholders para influir en el roadmap desde una visión centrada en usuario y basada en datos.  
* Diseñar experiencias a nivel journey end-to-end, garantizando coherencia en todos los puntos de contacto.  
* Definir y optimizar flujos de usuario, entendiendo la experiencia como un proceso continuo.  
* Aplicar metodologías de Design Thinking adaptadas a entornos dinámicos.  
* Detectar oportunidades mediante análisis de datos, research y benchmarking, generando hipótesis de mejora.  
* Validar soluciones a través de investigación cualitativa y cuantitativa, testing continuo y experimentación.  
* Definir y hacer seguimiento de KPIs de diseño y producto, incluyendo A/B testing y medición de impacto.  
* Comunicar insights y decisiones mediante storytelling y prototipos.  
* Diseñar alineado con design systems, asegurando consistencia y escalabilidad.  
* Garantizar accesibilidad e inclusión (WCAG).  
* Colaborar con equipos técnicos, entendiendo limitaciones y oportunidades tecnológicas.  
* Participar en la definición de arquitecturas de información y sistemas.  
* Contribuir a la mejora continua de procesos y cultura de diseño.  
* Actuar como referente de usuario en el equipo y mentorizar perfiles más junior.

✅ Requisitos

* Sólida experiencia en diseño de producto digital end-to-end en entornos complejos.  
* Alto nivel en UX, interacción y diseño visual.  
* Dominio de herramientas como Figma (prototipado y design systems).  
* Experiencia con herramientas de analítica y VoC (ej. Quantum Metric, Medallia).  
* Capacidad para trabajar con datos y definir métricas de éxito (KPIs).  
* Experiencia en experimentación y validación continua (A/B testing).  
* Conocimiento y aplicación de design systems a distintos niveles.  
* Experiencia en prototipado como herramienta principal de comunicación.  
* Conocimiento de accesibilidad (WCAG).  
* Experiencia en entornos ágiles y equipos multidisciplinares.  
* Buen entendimiento técnico (front-end y arquitectura).  
* Habilidades de comunicación, influencia y storytelling.

🌟 Qué ofrecemos

* Proyecto estratégico con impacto directo en negocio y producto.  
* Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, dinámico y orientado a datos.  
* Cultura centrada en el usuario, la innovación y la mejora continua.  
* Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento.  
* Participación en iniciativas de transformación digital de alto alcance.

🤝 ¿Te interesa formar parte de este reto?  
Si buscas un entorno donde el diseño tenga un papel clave en la toma de decisiones y quieras contribuir a generar experiencias que realmente marquen la diferencia, estaremos encantados de conocerte.

## About the job

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Product Engineer in Spain.

In this role, you will help shape the future of virtual healthcare by building intuitive, accessible, and clinically safe digital experiences used by patients and clinicians across multiple regions. You will operate at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, translating complex healthcare workflows into simple, effective user journeys. Working in a mission-driven environment, you will contribute directly to improving remote patient monitoring and virtual care systems used at scale across Europe. You will take ownership of both design and implementation, ensuring what ships is not only technically robust but also user-centric and inclusive. This is a highly collaborative role where engineering judgment, UX thinking, and product intuition are equally important. You will also leverage modern AI tooling to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards of safety and quality.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will take ownership of designing and building end-to-end user experiences for a healthcare platform that supports patients and clinicians in remote care settings. You will work across product discovery and delivery, ensuring that solutions are both technically sound and deeply user-focused.

* Design and develop high-quality front-end applications using React and TypeScript, ensuring performance, scalability, and maintainability  
* Translate complex clinical and operational requirements into intuitive, accessible user experiences across web and mobile interfaces  
* Contribute to product discovery by creating prototypes, testing concepts, and iterating based on user feedback and usability studies  
* Take ownership of UX quality in production, bridging the gap between design intent and shipped product  
* Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and engineers to define and refine feature requirements  
* Ensure product safety, compliance, and usability in a regulated healthcare environment  
* Leverage AI tools to improve development workflows, prototyping speed, and iterative product delivery

Requirements You bring strong experience as a product-focused engineer with the ability to combine software development, UX design, and product thinking. You are comfortable working in complex, user-critical environments and enjoy solving real-world problems with elegant solutions.

* Strong professional experience in front-end engineering using React, React Native, TypeScript, and modern CSS  
* Solid UX and product design skills, with the ability to create and evaluate user journeys and interaction flows  
* Proven experience delivering shipped products with a clear portfolio demonstrating impact and problem-solving approach  
* Ability to conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable product improvements  
* Familiarity with designing for accessibility and diverse user groups, including older or less digitally experienced users  
* Experience in regulated environments such as healthtech, fintech, or govtech is highly desirable  
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across product, engineering, and clinical stakeholders  
* Comfortable using AI tools to enhance productivity and accelerate development workflows

Benefits

* Competitive compensation package including salary and stock options  
* 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays, with flexibility to buy or sell additional days  
* Remote-first working model with optional office access and flexible arrangements across Europe  
* Private health insurance and comprehensive wellness support  
* Pension contributions and life insurance coverage  
* Learning and development budget to support professional growth  
* Remote working stipend and equipment support  
* Employee stock options and performance-based review cycles  
* Additional wellbeing perks including mental health support, fitness resources, and 24/7 GP access

How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best\!

## About the job

The Original Bitcoin Exchange

Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world.

We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all.

Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.

We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams.

Why Join Us?

Innovation

At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom.

Flexibility & Global Reach

We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground.

Fast-Paced & Impactful

Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future.

A Team that Thrives on Collaboration

We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities.

Grow with the Best

 At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry.

If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home\!

The Role:

As a Product Designer, you will be part of a small, high-impact design team shaping the Bitfinex product experience across web and mobile platforms.

This is a hands-on role with a high level of ownership, where you’ll be expected to move quickly, think independently, and contribute directly to product direction.

This includes:

Product Thinking

Work closely with product, engineering, and leadership to define problems, explore solutions, and drive clear, user-focused outcomes. You’ll be expected to think beyond screens and contribute to product direction.

End-to-End Design

Own the full design process from discovery and flows, through to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff. Ensure consistency, usability, and quality across all touchpoints.

User Experience

Design intuitive, scalable experiences that simplify complex financial workflows and make advanced trading tools accessible to a wide range of users.

Design Systems

Contribute to and evolve the design system to ensure consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the platform.

Collaboration

Work in an agile environment alongside engineers and product teams to iterate quickly and deliver high-quality outcomes.

What You Bring to the Table:

* At least 3 years of experience designing complex digital products, ideally within fintech, trading, or data-heavy platforms.  
* Strong product thinking. Able to solve problems, not just design screens.  
* Highly proficient in Figma, with experience working within and evolving design systems.  
* Comfortable operating in a small team with high ownership and minimal hand-holding.  
* Experience collaborating closely with developers and understanding technical constraints.  
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate decisions.  
* A sharp eye for detail, interaction design, and usability.  
* Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms.  
* Highly autonomous work ethic, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve the product and design processes.  
* Ability to work with ambiguous or incomplete information, exercising sound judgment to determine when to make assumptions and when to engage stakeholders for clarification.

Nice to have:

* Experience with trading platforms, financial products, or data visualization.  
* Degree or qualification in Design, UX/UI, HCI, Fine Arts, Multimedia Design, or related field (preferred but not mandatory depending on experience)

What We Offer:

* Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture  
* Mentorship & Growth  
* Competitive Pay  
* Career Development Opportunities  
* Supportive Team Environment  
* Learning & Knowledge Sharing  
* Team-Building Activities  
* Social activities (online & in-person)  
* A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative

Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all?

If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you\!

Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer

As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose.

All assessments and recruitment-related communications are conducted exclusively through official Bitfinex email addresses (e.g., firstname.lastname@bitfinex.com). Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means.

As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent. All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable.

Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process.

If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com. Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.

# **Product Designer**

[Apply](https://careers.stravito.com/jobs/7342996-product-designer)

### About the role

You know that corporate document or piece of research you know you have somewhere but you can’t seem to find it? 🤯 The struggle to gather, organize and visualize all corporate knowledge and insights is real.  
**We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.**

Design plays a central role in how we build Stravito. Our product helps global organizations unlock and use insights from market research and internal knowledge.

As a Product Designer, you’ll work closely with product managers and engineers to turn complex problems into clear, intuitive product experiences. Much of our design work involves making research knowledge and AI-driven workflows understandable, trustworthy, and easy to use.

You’ll be involved throughout the product development process—from early discovery to polished UI and shipped features—and have ownership of key product areas as the product evolves.  
**About the job**

Design and user experience (UX) are at the forefront of everything we do. The job of a User Experience Designer is to envision how people experience our products and bring that vision to life in a way that feels inspired, refined, and even magical. In the UX Designer role, you’ll transform complex tasks into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use designs —from the first-time user to the sophisticated expert. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Engineer,s and Product Managers throughout the design process—from creating user flows and wireframes to building user interface mockups and prototypes. At each stage, you will anticipate our users' needs, advocate for them, and ensure that the final product surprises and delights them.  
**What you’ll do**

* Lead design work across the product lifecycle—from discovery to implementation.  
* Turn user needs, product goals, and technical constraints into clear product experiences.  
* Work closely with product managers and engineers in small, collaborative teams.  
* Create flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.  
* Use research, feedback, and product thinking to guide design decisions.  
* Take ownership of problems and drive solutions from idea to shipped product.

**Who you are**

* A mid-to-senior level product designer with strong interaction and visual design skills.  
* Comfortable balancing product thinking with hands-on design work.  
* Experienced in designing and shipping digital products.  
* A clear communicator who collaborates well across design, product, and engineering.  
* Deeply user-focused and motivated to solve meaningful problems.  
* Highly proficient in Figma.

**If you’re interested, send us your application and portfolio**.

* If this role sounds interesting but you’re not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still like to hear from you.  
* **This role is remote-first, but to be eligible for employment you will need to be a resident for tax purposes in one of these locations: Germany, Spain, Sweden, The Netherlands, The United Kingdom.**

**What’s in it for you?**

You will join a remote-first and globally spread team, with company events a couple of times each year as the icing on the cake 🎂 We offer a fun, collaborative environment where everyone truly cares and helps each other. We have zero micro-management, and instead, you are encouraged to cultivate your own processes while giving and receiving feedback for improvement. Add to that a competitive compensation package, the possibility of working with cutting-edge technology in our industry (such as GenAI), and to be part of simplifying the professional lives of many \- what’s not to like?

If you’re interested, send us your application AND 👉 **your portfolio 👈**

We look forward to hearing from you.

## About the job

Product Designer

Join Hostinger, and we’ll grow fast\! 🚀

We’re shaping the future of online success — powered by AI and driven by people. With 900+ talented professionals and over 4 million clients in 150 countries, we help creators and entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life faster and easier than ever before.

Our mission: To provide tools that help individuals and small businesses succeed online faster and easier.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles

Our formula for success: Customer obsession, innovative products, and talented teams.

Your day-to-day

* Work with cross-functional teams to solve customers problems.  
* Create innovative solutions that meet customer needs and are extremely easy to use.  
* Own and drive the entire design process for your area: be the advocate for the user, responsible for the journey from first sketch to shipped feature, and then for monitoring its performance and iterating.  
* Conduct extensive user research to inform design decisions.  
* Iterate on exciting solutions based on received feedback and data.  
* Keep up-to-date with current design trends, techniques, and practices.  
* Actively collaborate with the design guild to improve our existing design systems and design processes.  
* Be autonomous and proactive. You’re going to be taking full ownership and responsibility for your work.  
* Provide and get actionable feedback from teammates.

Your Skills And Experience

* You have minimum 3+ years of experience designing for consumer-focused tech companies.  
* You have deep fluency in design thinking, user-centered methodologies, UX research, prototyping and iterative design — not just delivering UI screens, but understanding why and how those designs solve user & business problems.  
* You’re comfortable owning a design area end-to-end: making strategic design decisions, collaborating cross-functionally, balancing user needs, business goals and technical constraints, and driving execution through to launch.  
* You have excellent communication skills to clearly present your design ideas and solutions.  
* You can conduct user research, understand the data and validate ideas.  
* You have an excellent knowledge of design tools.  
* You have a great knowledge of design systems and can contribute to them.  
* You are driven, creative, and hungry for knowledge.  
* You have an impressive online portfolio that you’re desperate to show off.  
* Understanding of analytics tools such as Amplitude, HotJar.  
* Candidates must submit a portfolio (real design cases, thoughts behind the ideas and solutions, process, etc.) to be considered.

Benefits For You

🚀 360 Growth: We provide limitless learning opportunities: access to platforms like Reforge and CoachHub, global conferences, feedback culture, digital libraries, and industry-leading subscriptions. Advance your career with internal mobility, and grow with a team eager to share knowledge and support your success.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work on your terms, whether from the comfort of home or anywhere in the world. With a home office budget, you can elevate your workspace. Enjoy the flexibility to manage your schedule while bringing your ideas to life in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your health comes first with company-provided sick days, 20 paid suspension days, Headspace subscriptions, and recharge leave. Participate in wellbeing-dedicated events and simply enjoy the balance of a lifestyle that prioritizes wellness.

🎉 Work hard \- play hard: Celebrate your achievements with company events like Town Hall, Meet the Client initiatives, team-building experiences, and workations. Celebrate life’s big moments with milestone gifts for weddings, new parenthood, and graduations.

Compensation

* Gross salary from 4500 EUR/month depending on experience.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights\! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

Three. Two. Onboard

# Product Designer \- Integration

Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; Spain (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote)

### **Who we are**

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

## **About the Team**

This role sits within Product Design, Platform & Intelligence, focused on Integrations.  
The Integrations team is responsible for the experiences that help customers connect Typeform with the tools they already use, from CRMs and marketing platforms to automation systems, databases, collaboration tools, and emerging AI ecosystems.  
You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design partners to shape how integrations are discovered, configured, managed, and scaled across the Typeform platform.

## **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Product Designer to help shape the future of integrations at Typeform.  
This role will play a key part in building coherent, scalable, and high quality integrations experiences across the Apps & Integrations ecosystem, unified setup and connection flows, Automations entry points, and emerging Typeform AI connector experiences.  
You’ll work on customer problems that sit at the intersection of workflows, automation, platform design, and AI powered tooling. From simplifying setup flows to creating reusable connection patterns across product surfaces, your work will directly impact how customers activate and automate their workflows inside Typeform.  
This is a highly collaborative role where you’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, and other Designers to solve both tactical UX challenges and longer term platform problems.

## **Things you’ll do**

* Design intuitive and scalable integrations experiences across discovery, setup, configuration, permissions, and management flows  
* Help evolve shared UX patterns across integrations surfaces, including Apps & Integrations, Automations, admin experiences, and Typeform AI connectors  
* Lead end to end design work, from discovery and ideation through to execution and iteration  
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners to shape requirements early and reduce ambiguity during delivery  
* Plan and run workshops, user research sessions, usability testing, and design walkthroughs  
* Contribute to and leverage the Design System to create reusable patterns that scale across the platform  
* Help improve how customers discover, connect, and activate integrations across different parts of the product  
* Influence the long term design direction for scalable connection management and integrations platform experiences  
* Work on cross functional journeys where Integrations intersects with Workflows, Automations, response data, and AI powered experiences

## **Example projects you may work on**

* Evolving integrations discovery and management experiences across customer facing admin surfaces  
* Designing the unified “Connect to…” setup and connection management experience  
* Improving integrations experiences inside Automations, including workflows connected to tools like Google Sheets and HubSpot  
* Contributing to Typeform AI connector experiences across tools such as Notion, Slack, and Shopify  
* Helping shape reusable setup and management patterns as part of the long term scalable future of integrations initiative

## **What you already bring to the table**

* 4+ years of experience in digital product design  
* Experience designing SaaS products and complex product workflows  
* Strong experience working across the full product design process, from discovery to delivery  
* Experience designing integrations heavy, workflow automation, platform, or data focused products  
* Strong visual and interaction design skills with attention to usability and clarity  
* Experience conducting user research and incorporating findings into design decisions  
* Experience working with and contributing to Design Systems  
* Comfortable collaborating closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and cross functional stakeholders  
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions  
* Comfortable operating in fast moving environments with evolving priorities  
* A strong portfolio showcasing thoughtful product thinking and shipped work  
* Fluent in English

## **Nice to have**

* Experience with iPaaS ecosystems or integrations platforms  
* Experience designing AI powered product experiences or tool ecosystems  
* Experience creating shared platform patterns across multiple product surfaces  
* Experience working on marketer tools or workflow automation products

We **champion our diverse customer base** by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we **hold high expectations** for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.  
We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. # **Principal Product Designer**

[Apply](https://jobs.lever.co/lodgify/4bfe8973-38f5-44b3-b1cc-801a0770c0bc)

### About the role

⭐ **Who we are**

Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.

Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.

**⭐ Role Overview**

As a Principal Product Designer in the Customer Experience Group, you'll lead through design and own the strategy that brings our product experiences to life.

You'll be the driving force behind creating thoughtful, end-to-end solutions deeply rooted in customer needs, leveraging Design Thinking to ensure our products are as valuable as they are delightful.

This role is where strategic vision meets hands-on design: You'll influence and lead product direction, make high-impact decisions, and ensure every solution is grounded in empathy, research, and business insight.

Join a **design-driven culture** where your work will directly improve how we deliver value to our customers\!  
**⭐ How will you make an impact?**

* **Customer-Centric Strategy:** Lead the design strategy for your Customer Experience area, ensuring every decision starts with the customer and delivers measurable value.  
* **Shape Product Direction:** Partner closely with Product and business leadership to influence roadmap and strategy, ensuring customer experience is a first-class input, not an afterthought.  
* **Lead Through Design Thinking:** Drive a culture of bold problem-solving through ideation, co-creation, and iterative validation, helping teams ask better questions before jumping to solutions.  
* **Lean UX Approach**: Work iteratively, test early and frequently, adapt quickly to change, and deliver value early through close collaboration with cross-functional partners.  
* **Turn Research into Strategy:** Go beyond synthesis. Translate customer insights into a clear design strategy that aligns stakeholders and unlocks new opportunities.  
* **Own the End-to-End Journey:** Map, challenge, and reimagine user journeys to identify the high-leverage moments where great design creates the most impact.  
* **Prototype the Future:** Generate and test innovative concepts that push the experience forward, not just improve what already exists.  
* **Validate with Rigor:** Lead concept testing and partner with Product and Data on experiments that measure real impact and sharpen your design decisions.

,  
**⭐ What makes you a great fit?**

* You have a track record of **defining UX direction.** Not just delivering against it.  
* You've set vision, built design strategy, and shaped what "great" looks like in a product area.  
* You bring a **strong point of view** and the communication skills to make it land with peers, product leadership, and the business.  
* You're a **systems thinker** who sees the whole experience, not just individual screens, and you design accordingly.  
* You're deeply **customer-obsessed,** with a history of turning research into insight and insight into strategy.  
* You're an excellent collaborator who **raises the bar** for the teams around you, through craft, clarity, and conviction.  
* You have mastery of design tools (Figma and beyond), a solid command of design systems and accessibility, and the range to move from high-level strategy to high-fidelity execution.  
* You've contributed to **design culture.** Whether through mentorship, process improvement, or helping a team level up its practice

**Why you’ll love us:**

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.

**What's in it for you?\***

🏠 **Remote Flexibility**: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 **Time to Recharge:** 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 **Alan Health Insurance**: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 **Meal Perk:€150/month allowance** on your Alan card \+ 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 **Tax-Free Savings**: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ **Home Office Gear:** We provide a **table, ergonomic chair, and monitor** for your home setup.

🇪🇸 **Language Learning**: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 **Referrals:** Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 **Social Life:** Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 **Dynamic Hub:** A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

\*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued

**So, what are you waiting for?Apply now\!**

**All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉**

# **UX/UI Designer**

[SharePost](https://dribbble.com/jobs/304335-UX-UI-Designer?source=index#)[Copy](https://dribbble.com/jobs/304335-UX-UI-Designer)

**About Us**: COCONE EUROPE OÜ is the European subsidiary of Cocone Corporation, a Japanese company known for avatar-based social mobile experiences. We build consumer-facing mobile products focused on emotional connection, engagement, and long-term user relationships.

**About the Role**: We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer based in London (hybrid model) to take ownership of the user experience and interface design of a live mobile product on Android and iOS with built-in gamification.

This role is centered on reimagining and elevating the overall product experience. You will identify usability issues, rethink core flows, and drive improvements that enhance engagement, retention, and emotional connection. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and artists to ensure that design decisions are grounded in user needs while supporting business objectives.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own and drive end-to-end UX/UI design for a consumer-facing mobile application built in Unity.  
* Analyze existing user profiles and journeys to identify friction points, usability issues, and opportunities for improvement.  
* Redesign and optimize core product experiences with a strong focus on engagement and long-term retention.  
* Define UX hypotheses, validate them through testing, and iterate based on insights.  
* Design user flows, information architecture, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI for key features and systems.  
* Translate product goals and behavioral insights into intuitive and emotionally engaging user experiences.  
* Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ensure designs are feasible and effectively implemented.  
* Analyze user behavior data, usability testing results, and qualitative feedback to identify UX issues and opportunities.  
* Conduct UX audits and establish clear recommendations for improving usability, consistency, and accessibility.  
* Contribute to and evolve a cohesive design system to ensure consistency across the product.

**Requirements**

Experience

* 5+ years of professional UI/UX design experience for mobile applications.  
* Proven experience working on live products, including improving and iterating on existing experiences.  
* Experience owning UX for complex systems or feature sets, not just individual screens.  
* Strong track record of collaboration with product managers and engineers.  
* Experience contributing to product improvements tied to engagement or retention metrics.  
* Creating scalable design systems.

Skills

* Deep understanding of UX principles, interaction design, and information architecture.  
* Strong ability to diagnose UX problems and propose effective, scalable solutions.  
* Solid understanding of mobile platform conventions and constraints (Android and iOS).  
* Ability to clearly articulate design decisions and rationale.  
* High proficiency with modern design tools (Figma or equivalent).  
* Experience leveraging data, user feedback, and usability testing to guide design decisions.  
* Strong visual design skills with attention to detail, hierarchy, and consistency.  
* Understanding and ability to apply gamification principles in UX.

Soft Skills

* High level of ownership and accountability.  
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  
* Comfort working in an international environment.  
* Proactive, problem-solving mindset.  
* Strong attention to product quality and user experience.

Nice to Have

* Experience with social features, avatar systems, or emotionally-driven digital experiences.  
* Familiarity with accessibility best practices.  
* Experience contributing to or scaling design systems.  
* Experience mentoring or guiding other designers.  
* Experience implementing UI assets in Unity.

**Interview Process**

* Initial Interview (30–45 minutes)  
* Practical Test (2–3 days)  
* Design Review & Deep Dive (60–90 minutes)  
* Final Interview & Offer Discussion (30–40 minutes)  
* 2-Month Probation Period  
* Full-Time Offer

**How to Apply**

* Please send your application via email to: **talent\_uk@cocone.co.jp**  
  * **Email Subject:** Application for UX/UI Designer – \[Your Name\]  
  * **Required Documents:**  
    * Resume (PDF)  
    * Portfolio (if applicable)  
    * Please include a brief introduction of yourself in the email body.

# **Diseñador de Producto Senior (UX/UI)**

[SharePost](https://dribbble.com/jobs/299615-Dise-ador-de-Producto-Senior-UX-UI?source=index#)[Copy](https://dribbble.com/jobs/299615-Dise-ador-de-Producto-Senior-UX-UI)

**Empresa:** OTIF

**Ubicación:** Remoto

**Tipo de empleo:** Tiempo completo

**Descripción del puesto:**

En OTIF estamos transformando la industria logística mediante la digitalización y la integración de redes globales de suministro. Buscamos un Diseñador de Producto Senior con sólida experiencia en UX/UI para liderar el diseño de soluciones digitales que optimicen la orquestación de cadenas de suministro, plataformas de seguimiento en tiempo real y herramientas de integración transfronteriza.

**Responsabilidades principales:**

●    	Liderar el diseño y la experiencia de usuario end-to-end de productos digitales, desde la investigación de usuarios hasta la implementación de interfaces intuitivas, eficientes y accesibles.

●    	Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de producto, desarrollo, operaciones, y stakeholders para crear wireframes, prototipos y flujos de usuario que resuelvan problemáticas complejas de logística, tales como personalización de envíos, garantías de precio y gestión de capacidad de carga.

●    	Planear y ejecutar pruebas de usabilidad, así como iteraciones basadas en retroalimentación de usuarios clave (shippers, carriers y freight forwarders).

●    	Diseñar experiencias responsivas para aplicaciones web y móviles enfocadas en rastreo en tiempo real, facturación consolidada y operación de ecosistemas regionales.

●    	Contribuir a la visión estratégica del producto, considerando retos como la interoperabilidad entre proveedores, la adopción de modelos digitales y la fragmentación del mercado logístico.

●    	Ser mentor a diseñadores junior y promover buenas prácticas de UX/UI dentro del equipo.

**Requisitos:**

●    	Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como Diseñador de Producto o UX/UI en entornos digitales, preferentemente tecnología B2B.

●    	Dominio avanzado de herramientas de diseño como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch o similares. Experiencia en prototipado con InVision, [Proto.io](http://proto.io/) u otras plataformas equivalentes.

●    	Conocimientos sólidos en UX research, diseño de user journeys, pruebas A/B y principios de accesibilidad (WCAG).

●    	Experiencia diseñando plataformas digitales complejas, con énfasis en datos en tiempo real y visualización de información (por ejemplo, dashboards de tracking de envíos).

●    	Licenciatura en Diseño Gráfico, Interacción Humano-Computadora o carrera afín. Certificaciones en UX/UI son consideradas un plus.

**Habilidades blandas:**

●    	Excelente comunicación, capacidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios y enfoque a resultados en entornos ágiles.

**Idiomas:**

●    	Español fluido e inglés avanzado para colaboración internacional.

 

**Opcionales:**

●    	Conocimientos en logística o supply chain son deseables.

**Ofrecemos:**

●    	Salario competitivo, según experiencia y perfil.

●    	Prestaciones que incluyen esquema de trabajo remoto, capacitaciones en tendencias digitales y plataformas líderes del sector logístico.

●    	Ambiente innovador con enfoque en retorno de inversión tecnológica y toma de decisiones basada en datos.

●    	Oportunidad de generar impacto global mediante el desarrollo de soluciones utilizadas en más de 200 países.

**Postulación:**

●    	Las personas interesadas deberán enviar su CV y portafolio a los correos: rh@otif.mx y marcela.hernandez@otif.mx.

## About the job

Who We Are  
We are a global content, creative and digital organisation delivering high‑quality design across platforms, campaigns and multi‑market ecosystems. Our digital design teams combine creativity, craft and technical capability to create world‑class experiences.  
What We Do  
We design digital assets, web interfaces, social content, toolkits, layouts and component‑based systems for global brands. Our teams collaborate across creative, UX, UI, content, production and development to deliver scalable, on‑brand digital design.  
Job Summary  
We’re looking for a Senior Digital Designer to lead high‑craft digital design across campaigns, platforms and multi‑market toolkits. You will produce best‑in‑class visual design, elevate creative output, and collaborate closely with creative and technical teams. Ideal for a designer with strong digital craft, brand sensibility and ability to work across formats.  
Responsibilities

* Design high‑quality digital assets across web, social, mobile, CRM and paid media.  
* Lead visual design across toolkits, branding systems, and multi‑market templates.  
* Collaborate with creative directors, UX and UI teams on concepting and visual development.  
* Ensure all digital outputs meet brand, accessibility and technical standards.  
* Develop component‑based systems, templates and scalable design frameworks.  
* Produce polished layouts, typography, motion references and final assets.  
* Work closely with developers to ensure design feasibility and accuracy.  
* Support junior designers with feedback, craft guidance and best‑practice direction.  
* Contribute to innovation, emerging trends and continuous improvement.

Requirements

* Extensive experience as a Digital Designer or Senior Designer within digital‑first environments.  
* Expertise with Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma and digital design tools.  
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, responsive design and component systems.  
* Exceptional layout, typography, colour and visual craft skills.  
* Ability to deliver high‑volume, multi‑format design under tight deadlines.  
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams.  
* Calm, detail‑focused and creatively driven approach.  
* Healthcare experience is a plus.  
* English is a plus.

What we offer

OverviewCandidature  
Job Title: Senior UI/UX Designer

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Timezone Requirement: Must have at least 4 hours overlap with PST

Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer who is obsessed with clarity, usability, and beautiful interfaces. You’ll own the end-to-end design of key product surfaces—from discovery and flows to high-fidelity UI—working closely with Product Managers and Engineers to ship world-class experiences.

This role is ideal for someone who can think strategically, execute with precision, and raise the design bar across the entire organization.

Key Responsibilities:

* Own product design from concept to execution across web platforms.  
* Translate complex workflows into simple, intuitive user experiences.  
* Create user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma.  
* Maintain and evolve our design system for consistency and scalability.  
* Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ship pixel-perfect UI.  
* Conduct usability testing and incorporate feedback into iterations.  
* Advocate for the user in product and roadmap discussions.  
* Ensure designs are accessible, performant, and aligned with brand identity.

What We’re Looking For:

* 4+ years of experience in UI/UX or Product Design for web products.  
* Deep expertise in Figma (components, auto-layout, prototyping, design systems).  
* Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product thinking.  
* Excellent understanding of UX principles, interaction design, and visual hierarchy.  
* Experience designing complex SaaS or B2B products.  
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with PMs and Engineers.  
* High attention to detail and passion for pixel-perfect execution.  
* Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous startup environments.

Nice to Have:

* Experience building or scaling a design system.  
* Familiarity with frontend constraints (React, CSS, responsive layouts).  
* Experience working in AI or developer-focused products.

## About the job

Who We Are  
At Balance (findbalance.app), we're building the clinical operating system for obesity treatment — combining medical rigor, AI intelligence, and multidisciplinary care teams to deliver personalized treatment at scale.   
In Spain alone, 200,000 people on GLP-1 medications today will grow to 1.2 million by 2030, most without access to proper clinical support.  We're fixing that.  We've proven our approach works and we have just closed our Seed Series funding.  Join us if you're obsessed with outcomes, not vanity metrics — and ready to help thousands of patients actually see results and feel better.  
About the role  
We're looking for a generalist, comfortable wearing many hats (UX, UI, research, sometimes frontend coding). We need a strong product thinker, focused on user needs and business metrics over pure visual aesthetics. You must be someone who can do (design with full autonomy as an individual contributor) and think (raise the bar for the entire design function). Someone who understands that UX in healthcare isn't just usability — it's adherence, trust, and behavior change.  
What you will do  
As an individual contributor:

* Design flows, screens, and interactions for the patient app and clinical dashboard, from discovery through delivery  
* Translate clinical and product requirements into clear, empathetic, and usable experiences  
* Maintain high design quality in a fast-iteration environment

As a leader:

* Collaborate across mixed profiles (product, clinical, marketing, engineering, partners)  
* Facilitate co-design sessions and workshops with stakeholders across the company  
* Be the design voice in cross-functional conversations  
* Take strategic, end-to-end ownership of the design process and actively set up the foundation for future design hiring

As a design system owner:

* Establish design principles and standards the team can apply independently  
* Lead the design and maintenance of our design system — components, tokens, documentation, governance  
* Identify and prioritize systemic usability and visual quality improvements across the platform

As a fervent patients’ advocate:

* Professionalize our research function: methodologies, cadence, synthesis, and connection to product decisions  
* Conduct interviews, usability tests, and contextual studies with patients and the clinical team  
* Build an insights repository that continuously feeds the roadmap

What we're looking for  
Must-haves:

* 5+ years of UX/product design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end work  
* Demonstrated ability to link design decisions directly to measurable business or clinical outcomes (e.g., adherence rates, conversion, retention).  
* Experience building or evolving a design system in production  
* Strong command of Figma and prototyping and user testing tools  
* Real familiarity with AI-assisted workflows — generative tools, accelerated prototyping, or integrating language models into design processes  
* Native or fluent Spanish; professional-level English — we read, write, and debate in both languages

Nice-to-haves:

* Ability to conduct research rigorously and connect findings to product decisions  
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS/modern frontend concepts for effective communication with engineers  
* Experience in service design or complex multi-actor systems like 2-sided marketplaces  
* Experience mentoring or managing people (even informally)  
* Prior work in health, wellness, or behavior change products  
* Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design

What we offer

* Competitive salary based on experience  
* Work hybridly from our Madrid offices or remotely from anywhere in Spain  
* Impact since day one: the work you do here shapes the experience of thousands of patients  
* Solve a real problem with real consequences: obesity is the most underestimated epidemic of our time  
* Genuine autonomy and ownership — no layers of design bureaucracy   
* A team that believes design isn't decoration but a clinical and competitive advantage  
* Opportunity to adopt frontier AI on internal workflows and patient-facing features

Asking questions is an important part of our culture, so we’d like to give you an opportunity to ask any immediate questions you might have for us below.

At Oxford University Press, I led the redesign of a digital educational platform end-to-end.

I started by analyzing the existing product, running interviews with teachers, and validating issues through usability testing. I also worked closely with commercial, customer support, and legal teams to understand business constraints, user pain points, and requirements related to new accessibility regulations.

From there, I redefined the information architecture and user flows to simplify complex processes, reorganize content, and improve clarity and messaging across different user contexts.

I developed a consistent visual language and a scalable design system, aligned with development by adapting it to Bootstrap. I also explored how to connect the UK platform with the local one, ensuring technical feasibility throughout.

I used the prototype to run validation sessions and created reports to communicate findings and progress across the company.

Before handoff, I ran final iterations and defined a phased implementation approach to support development and rollout.

The result was a more coherent, accessible, and scalable experience aligned with user, business, and technical needs.

# **UX Designer \- Design systems**

Home based \- EMEA

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a UX designer for our Design System Team. 

You will play a key role making open source software available to the world. Our Design function ensures the experience of the software and infrastructure we build is true to our intentions, and delivers the tools our community and customers need. The Design System UX designer makes that possible by defining, evolving and advocating for a consistent use of design system that scales across our products.

This role sits in the design system team reporting to Design Systems Management

Location: *This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.*

**The role entails**

* Building and evolving Canonical’s design system, ensuring measurable adoption, consistency, scalability and accessibility across our products  
* Collaborating with designers, engineers and stakeholders to translate user needs and brand principles into reusable components, patterns and guidelines  
* Championing design system best practices, advocating for cohesive user experience and design, providing documentation and support for cross-functional teams  
* Designing and documenting UI components, design tokens and interaction patterns  
* Ensuring timely and efficient delivery of the roadmap  
* Enabling alignment on design system usage and governance across teams  
* Advocating for accessibility, performance, and scalability in design system decisions and iterating based on data and technological advancements  
* Staying ahead of industry trends, ensuring innovation and balancing it with system coherence and performance

## **What we are looking for in you**

* Relevant experience in UX/product design, with a strong focus on design systems in complex environments  
* A portfolio demonstrating strong expertise in design systems, including component libraries, documentation and handling complex environments  
* Exceptional educational achievements in design or related behavioral science discipline  
* Expertise in Figma, Storybook and design token workflows  
* Experience of collaborating with engineers and bridging design and code  
* Proven ability to apply design process and clearly communicate and document design decisions  
* Excellent attention to detail and systemic approach to solving complex design challenges  
* Commitment to transparent project delivery and owning team deadlines  
* A passion for balancing consistency and innovation  
* Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

[Read more about the design team](https://canonical.design/)

### **What we offer colleagues**

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person  
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year  
* Annual compensation review  
* Recognition rewards  
* Annual holiday leave  
* Maternity and paternity leave  
* Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform  
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues  
* Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

###  **About Canonical**

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

###  **Canonical is an equal opportunity employer**

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. [Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.](https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity)

## About the job

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has helped people and teams achieve–well, anything. From seamless work management to smart, scalable solutions, we’ve always worked with flow. We’re building tools that empower teams to automate the manual, uncover insights, and scale smarter. But more than that, we’re creating space– space to think big, take action, and unlock the kind of work that truly matters. Because when challenge meets purpose, and passion turns into progress, that’s magic at work, and it’s what we show up for everyday.

As the Director of Product Design, you will lead and grow a diverse and talented team of Product Designers in applying principles of design thinking to conceptualize engaging and personalized user experiences for our web and mobile apps. You have a solid history of making the people around you better. You drive quality and efficiency by establishing processes, developing talent, and leveraging your own expertise and experience to help coach your team to accomplish more than they might have without you. You see yourself as a team captain more than a coach.

You are skilled at scaling your influence and abilities. You love to collaborate with designers, user researchers, engineers, product managers, executives, and inspire them to do their best. You thrive on working well with others… and getting things done. You will represent the end user and evangelize human-centered methodologies across the product team to ensure innovative designs that truly meet people’s needs from first-time users to seasoned experts.

You will report to our VP of Product Design located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will

* Help establish, drive and articulate a vision for the future of design at Smartsheet.  
* Define the user experience strategy and vision for your areas of oversight.  
* Establish goals and target metrics that design decisions can be mapped to.  
* Manage the day-to-day and strategic activities of UX designers, making sure that the human-centered process is properly planned and followed.  
* Build, evolve and scale UX processes, standards, and tools.  
* Mentor and coach UX designers in a motivating and supportive manner and keep the team on top of emerging UX techniques and tools.  
* Develop career paths and programs tailored to individual team member professional development.  
* Gain a deep understanding of user needs and goals and communicate them to cross functional product teams.  
* Create alignment with other groups within the company by working collaboratively with product teams to launch new features and evolve existing ones based on an understanding of user needs, business objectives and technical constraints.  
* Translate business goals into innovative, creative and engaging product experiences.  
* Support other duties.

You Have

* 12+ years of experience in a highly cross-functional role running strategic projects from idea through implementation.  
* 6+ years leading & mentoring UX teams, manager of managers a plus.  
* Successful experience leading a large team of designers (10+).  
* Examples of broadly influential UX work that contributed directly to the achievement of business goals.  
* Experience designing for enterprise SaaS platforms.  
* Passion for the field of User Experience. Self motivated and enthusiastic; knows when it's necessary to seek out guidance.  
* Experience facilitating activities to gather insights on user needs and goals and conducting usability testing.  
* Experience finding simple, innovative solutions for complex problems.  
* Experience with Agile methodologies.  
* Strong visual design skills and sensibilities.  
* Expert in Figma, Creative Cloud or other visual design, wireframing, and prototyping tools. Proficiency in rapid prototyping.  
* Highly organized with planning, conducting, and tracking work.  
* Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills; ability to work successfully with teams across the organization, including Product Management and Engineering.  
* Ability to articulate design decisions and advocate for the user.

Current US Perks & Benefits

* Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees  
* 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

* Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off  
* US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans  
* US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year  
* Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave  
* Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community  
* Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses  
* Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account  
* Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)
