## About the job

At Reverse Tech, we are on a mission to create, launch, and scale digital product brands in the health and wellness space. Our goal is ambitious – we aim to help 10 million people improve their health by 2026 through hyper-targeted, mass-scale brands. We specialize in subscription-based business models and pride ourselves on being results-focused, with no big egos, just big data.

What We Want To Achieve

Our vision is to discover novel self-serve solutions to the world's greatest health problems, all while adhering to our core values.

We're looking for a UI/UX & Visual Designer who will be a vital part of our dynamic remote team. Your role will focus on designing and optimizing landing pages and microsites to improve user engagement and conversion rates, while also a continuously polishing our current funnels. The ideal candidate blends strategic thinking with design expertise, ensuring every asset contributes to business growth. You will play a key role in the design system optimization and you are a passionate about systems, creating a rationale structure that enables the development of a large and easy-to-understand framework. As we build our brand from the ground up, you'll have the opportunity to shape its visual identity, design language, and overall user experience strategy.

Requirements

*UI/UX Design*

* Design and enhance user interfaces for landing pages and microsites, developing wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups that align with marketing goals, business objectives, usability, and aesthetics.  
* Collaborate with developers and different stakeholders to ensure fast-loading, mobile-optimized, and SEO-friendly designs that support campaign success.  
* Use A/B testing, analytics, and user feedback to improve performance metrics, such as click-through rates (CTR), bounce rates, and conversion rates.  
* Work closely with fellow designers to improve and expand the design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across UI components.

*Visual Design*

* Generate and refine concepts for organic marketing across different channels including Google, Meta, and TikTok. Become the expert of how to treat each channel.  
* Collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional teams to integrate feedback and ensure designs meet the brand's strategic objectives as well as business objectives.  
* Iterate rapidly in a fast-paced environment, consistently refining designs to optimize performance and engagement.  
* A creative thinker with a strategic approach who is able to understand marketers needs and translate complex ideas into striking designs.

Desired Skills

* Experience collaborating and creating design systems to ensure consistency across digital properties.  
* 5+ years of experience in UI/UX and visual design, ideally in a performance-driven marketing environment.  
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.  
* Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), and digital marketing best practices.  
* Experience working with analytics tools to measure and improve design effectiveness.  
* Excellent ability to translate marketing and business goals into high-impact design solutions.

Our Values:

* Care: We support and stand by our team members in any situation, ensuring that no one is left behind.  
* Extreme Ownership: We take responsibility not only for tasks under our direct control but for anything that impacts our mission's success.  
* Identification: We take pride in being part of something bigger than ourselves, with the goal of changing the world by helping people get healthier.  
* Communication: We value honesty and direct language, fostering a culture free of politics.  
* Performance: We believe in providing full freedom while striving for top-notch performance from everyone.  
* Trust: We value the words and qualities of our team members, fostering an environment of trust and respect

Benefits What Our Team Members Get

* 100% remote and flexible work hours  
* Top notch equipment (MacBook Pro or PC, you decide)  
* Full-time employment  
* Learning from the best, including ex-Googlers and more  
* Unlimited growth prospects  
* Inclusion in a winning team  
* Competitive compensation  
* A fun, non-corporate atmosphere

If you're passionate about UX/UI Visual Design, and are ready to join a dynamic, global team, we encourage you to apply. Help us shape the future of health and wellness through technology.

Learn more about us at [https://www.reverse.tech/](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Ereverse%2Etech%2F&urlhash=VTZ5&isSdui=true) and apply today to become a key player in our exciting journey.

* This position is offered as a Full Remote option, reach out to us to evaluate the options according to your location.

## About the job

What will you be doing?  
Experience Designers are responsible for the design of digitally enabled products and services. They use their broad skillset across the service, interaction, and visual design domains to work on holistic design solutions, from early-stage idea generation until detailed design of service features and user stories in a digital product.  
As a Senior Experience Designer, you are expected to represent depth in the craft of experience design: as an individual contributor, as a mentor and guide for more junior colleagues, and as a contributor to the global community of practice. You will often be the backbone of your projects from beginning to end. You will plan, prioritise, and deliver experience design activities autonomously, in the context of interdisciplinary projects. You will lead client conversations within your domain, providing articulate recommendations and helping guide client choices. You will have opportunities to lead small teams on projects and contribute to business development through proposal-writing and pitches.  
Your fellow frogs will rely on you to:  
· Lead cross-disciplinary analysis of existing solutions and opportunity spaces and drive user understanding among different parties through workshop activities  
· Define digital product and convergent experience concepts in collaboration with the strategy and technology teams  
· Execute the detailed design of defined experiences working across the service components, interaction logins and visual language expression  
· Enable a successful handover of final outcomes to the client through training and documentation  
· Advocate for and pursue cross-disciplinary and convergent opportunity areas for design innovation  
On a typical project you will:  
· Understand goals, business requirements and constraints, market opportunities and user needs to help define opportunity areas and experience requirements  
· Plan, conduct, and synthesise research, testing and piloting activities with service users, providers, and SMEs  
· Map existing and to-be experiences, across both front and back office and actors involved, through journey maps, blueprints, and ecosystem maps  
· Create digital product and convergent experience concepts together with the team that push the bar for quality in a given field/industry  
· Support the definition of new product/service value proposition and implementation roadmaps  
· Create narratives that help tell the story of the work in an impactful way  
· Design wireframes, screens, and prototypes to illustrate product behaviour along defined used cases  
· Document product/service requirements and guidelines for following stages of implementation  
We want you to have:  
· 5+ years of professional experience in experience design (although you might have had a different job title, like “UX designer” or “product designer”)  
· Highly developed design skills, demonstrated in your portfolio of recent work  
· Confident presentation and storytelling abilities  
· Experience collaborating in multifunctional teams as the experience design lead  
· Proficiency with contemporary design and prototyping tools and methods  
· Affinity with frog’s values, and a passion for creating products that meet peoples functional and emotional needs  
· Business level ability in English  
It would be a bonus if you had:  
· A university degree in Interaction Design, Visual Communications, Human Computer Interaction, or a related design or behavioural science discipline  
· Experience working in a variety of organisations (start-up, corporate, agency/consultancy)  
· Academic, professional, or life experience from outside the design field that enriches your perspective as a designer  
Application Instructions  
· As part of your application, please include a link or PDF of your portfolio of recent work, highlighting your abilities and experience relevant to the role, with specific examples of how you work, think, collaborate, and contribute to great design outcomes. Please note that we are unable to accept any applications without a portfolio.

**The Opportunity:**  
You'll be more than a designer—you'll shape how we build with generative AI for a $1B+ e-commerce brand. Your mandate is to embed AI-first methodology into daily design execution, leveraging cutting-edge GenAI tools to create exceptional user experiences. The goal: accelerate creative output and drive customer conversion.  
**What You'll Own:**

* **Design & Deliver Core Experiences:** Produce end-to-end design artifacts, including wireframes, high-fidelity compositions, and interactive prototypes for key e-commerce pages and marketing landing pages.  
* **Execute AI-Powered Workflows:** Master and utilize our core GenAI toolkit—including Figma AI, Nano, Banana Vertex AI, and other cutting-edge tools—to rapidly create and iterate on page layouts, image concepts, and copy variants.  
* **Champion AI Tool Innovation:** Proactively research, test, and recommend emerging GenAI tools that can enhance the design team's workflow, speed, and creative quality to keep our practice at the industry's cutting edge.  
* **Craft Next-Generation UIs:** Design intuitive and effective user interfaces for AI-powered features, including semantic search results, conversational shopping assistants, and personalized recommendation modules.  
* **Contribute to the Design System:** Help maintain and evolve our design system, ensuring components and tokens are robust, responsive, and compatible with AI-generated variants while upholding brand consistency.  
* **Support Conversion Optimization:** Collaborate with Growth and Engineering teams to execute A/B tests and other experiments, translating data-driven insights into tangible design improvements.  
* **Ensure Quality & Accessibility:** Produce high-quality, developer-ready design specifications using Figma's Dev Mode and apply AI-assisted tools to help ensure all designs meet WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards.

**What You Bring:**

* **3-5 years of experience in web design:** Preferably from an e-commerce background.  
* **A strong portfolio showcasing shipped product work:** With a clear connection to business metrics (e.g., conversion lift, improved engagement) on detail pages, listing pages, or checkout flows.  
* **Expert Figma proficiency:** Including components, variables, and Dev Mode.  
* **Hands-on experience with modern GenAI design tools:** (e.g., Figma AI, Nano Banana, Vertex AI, Midjourney etc.) in a professional workflow, with a portfolio demonstrating your ability to guide them to brand-aligned outcomes.  
* **A demonstrable passion for the AI space:** With a proven ability to quickly learn, evaluate, and integrate new technologies and tools into your design process.  
* **Familiarity with emerging UX patterns for AI:** Such as conversational search, assistant UIs, and recommendation modules.  
* **Excellent communication skills:** With an ability to articulate design rationale and present research on new tools clearly.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* **Experience designing chat or guided-selling flows.**  
* **Comfort collaborating on experiments (A/B testing, multivariate) and understanding their purpose.**  
* **Working knowledge of WCAG 2.2 and foundational SEO principles for e-commerce.**

**Who You'll Work With:**  
You'll be part of the design team shaping the future of e-commerce experiences, collaborating with:

* **AI-First UI/UX Design Manager** — Direct reporting line  
* **Marketing** — Align on campaigns and brand initiatives  
* **CRO** — Partner on A/B tests and conversion experiments  
* **Content Team** — Collaborate on copy and creative assets  
* **Developers** — Ship designs with Dev Mode handoffs  
* **QA** — Ensure design quality and consistency in production

*Our team includes alumni from Apple, Deutsche Bank, Deloitte to name a few.*  
**Your Trajectory Here:**  
This isn't a static role. Based on your skills and interests, you can grow into:

* **Senior UI/UX Designer** — Deepen your craft and lead complex projects  
* **Design Lead** — Guide design direction and mentor other designers  
* **Design Project Manager** — Own project execution and cross-functional delivery

What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

About the job

Desarrolla tus competencias como Diseñador UX/UI para un gran proyecto de gran impacto.

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso, si tienes experiencia en Diseñador UX/UI nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Te unes a nuestro \#WelcomeHome? ¡Sigue leyendo\!

¿Qué buscamos?

Mínimo 4–5 años de experiencia en diseño UI/UX.

Experiencia demostrable participando en la creación o evolución de al menos un sistema de diseño (portfolio obligatorio).

Experiencia trabajando en equipos de producto con metodologías ágiles.

Comprensión básica de HTML/CSS y del proceso de desarrollo frontend.

Experiencia creando y manteniendo librerías de componentes escalables.

Conocimientos de accesibilidad web (WCAG 2.1).

Experiencia con herramientas de documentación (Notion, Confluence, Storybook o similares).

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Auditar y analizar la UI actual de nuestros productos para identificar patrones y portunidades de estandarización.

Diseñar y documentar el sistema de diseño (fundamentos, componentes y patrones).

Colaborar con dirección de arte para traducir la identidad de marca en componentes digitales funcionales.

Crear y mantener librerías de componentes en Figma con estructura escalable.

Definir design tokens (colores, tipografía, espaciado, etc.) y acompañar su correcta implementación.

Trabajar con el equipo frontend para asegurar la viabilidad técnica y correcta implementación del sistema.

Documentar guías de uso, mejores prácticas y casos de uso para todo el equipo.

Iterar y evolucionar el sistema basándose en feedback del producto y necesidades de los equipos.

Contribuir a la adopción progresiva del sistema de diseño en los distintos productos.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?

Modalidad 100% teletrabajo

Formar parte de una gran empresa competitiva y en continuo crecimiento.

Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.

Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.

Beneficios sociales y plan de compensación flexible.

Retribución competitiva.

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España tenemos una facturación de 337 millones de euros, 10 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.500 personas.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullece ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades, independientemente del género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

## About the job

🚀 Únete a MCA | Oportunidad UX/UI Designer/ Product Designer en entorno internacional  
Como empresa internacional de ingeniería y alta tecnología, en MCA potenciamos el talento y colaboramos con grandes compañías industriales en proyectos de vanguardia.  
Con más de 30 años de experiencia y un equipo de 1.450 personas, nos hemos consolidado como un actor clave en los sectores de ingeniería y alta tecnología.  
Nuestro crecimiento continuo nos ha permitido consolidar y ampliar nuestra presencia en Europa, con operaciones en Francia, Bélgica, Alemania, Países Bajos, Suecia, Italia y España.  
En MCA encontrarás proyectos tecnológicos reales, acompañamiento técnico y oportunidades de desarrollo profesional desde el primer día.  
UX/UI Designer/ Product Designer  
📍Ubicación:Madrid/Barcelona  
🏢 Modalidad: Híbrida-Presencial  
💼 Nivel: Mid-level / Senior  
💰 Salario: Según expericiencia  
🧠 ¿En qué consistirá tu trabajo?  
Serás responsable de diseñar experiencias digitales completas, combinando investigación de usuario y diseño visual para crear productos intuitivos, atractivos y alineados con los objetivos del negocio.  
Participarás en todo el ciclo de diseño: desde el análisis de necesidades y definición de flujos de usuario hasta la creación de wireframes, prototipos y diseños finales. Trabajarás estrechamente con equipos de producto y desarrollo para asegurar que las soluciones sean funcionales, coherentes y centradas en el usuario.  
🛠 Funciones principales  
Investigación de usuario y análisis de necesidades. Definición de arquitectura de información y user flows. Creación de wireframes y prototipos interactivos. Diseño visual de interfaces web y mobile. Colaboración con equipos de desarrollo para correcta implementación. Participación en testing de usabilidad y mejora continua. Creación y mantenimiento de design systems.  
👤 Qué buscamos  
Experiencia como UX/UI Designer en entornos digitales. Dominio de herramientas como Figma, Adobe XD o Sketch. Conocimientos en research, usabilidad y diseño centrado en usuario. Experiencia en diseño responsive y mobile-first. Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle. Habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. Nivel alto de inglés.  
📈 Plan de crecimiento  
Participación en proyectos digitales estratégicos. Evolución hacia roles de Senior UX/UI o Product Designer. Formación continua y desarrollo profesional.  
📩 ¿Te interesa diseñar experiencias digitales end-to-end?  
Aplica o escríbenos por LinkedIn y te contamos más.

## About the job

Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

How does Docplanner Tech fit here?

At [Docplanner Tech](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdocplanner%2Etech%2F&urlhash=XKot&isSdui=true) we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our [reviews on Glassdoor](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eglassdoor%2Ees%2FOverview%2FWorking-at-DocPlanner-EI_IE1071394%2E11%2C21%2Ehtm%3FcountryRedirect%3Dtrue&urlhash=WyB1&isSdui=true) speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, [here’s a video of us](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbit%2Ely%2F3xwnSAk&urlhash=qQ2H&isSdui=true).

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

Job Description

We are hiring for an open Senior Product Designer position on the Practice Management Systems team, offering a unique opportunity to influence varied aspects of our product landscape. The scope of the role will be focused on, but not limited to improving doctor's experience during the visit.

Who are we looking for?

As a Senior Product Designer, your expertise in delivering high-quality work will help us create a seamless experience for doctors, and clinics using our products. You'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on both product decisions and the overall roadmap. Your role will be crucial in simplifying complex systems, and you'll be involved in every step of the process—from defining the product vision to collaborating with Product Managers, Researchers, Engineering Leads, and Leadership Team.

You'll prototype and scale products that are used by thousands of doctors and clinic staff every day, ensuring a seamless and impactful user experience. You'll contribute to creating intuitive, efficient, and innovative solutions that meet the needs of our users.

How would you be impacting our mission?

We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled Senior Product Designer to join our team:

Lead cross-functional collaboration with product managers, engineers, and key stakeholders to align on strategic goals and ensure successful execution of design solutions across the organization.

Drive the design vision and strategy, continuously iterating on solutions based on user insights, data analysis, and evolving market trends to push for product innovation and excellence.

Build multichannel solutions, where experiences are seamlessly integrated between desktop, web and mobile touch points.

Be a key advocate for user-centered design principles, embedding empathy and user research at the core of the product development process.

In collaboration with Platform Designers guide the evolution of our Design System, Watson, ensuring consistency, scalability, and flexibility across products, while also contributing to the overall design language.

Stay at the forefront of AI and technology trends, identifying opportunities to integrate new tools, methodologies, and approaches that will elevate the user experience and maintain a competitive edge.

Lead the design research process, including user testing sessions and usability studies, to validate design decisions and gather timely and actionable insights that drive informed design solutions.

Champion and shape the company's design culture, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and creative environment where diverse perspectives are encouraged, and innovative ideas thrive.

What will set you up for success in this role?

* Fluency in English.  
* 6+ years of experience in Product Design, with a track record of leading successful design projects from inception to execution.  
* Expertise in traditional design tools such as Figma and integration of AI-first workflows using Claude, Gemini, Stitch or any other AI agents that will help scale design impact.  
* Strategic thinking—with the ability to drive product vision and design strategy autonomously and impact-driven decision-making.  
* Strong experience in hypothesis generation, experimentation, A/B testing, and data-informed decision-making.  
* Demonstrated leadership in collaborating with cross-functional teams including product management, research, engineering, and data analysis to deliver business and user value.  
* Experience working with data, business KPIs, and success metrics to align design efforts with broader company goals.  
* Deep understanding of systems thinking and component-based design principles, with the ability to scale design practices across teams.  
* Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.  
* Skilled in giving and receiving feedback to elevate the quality of design work across the team.  
* Adaptability navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities without compromising quality or momentum.  
* Growth mindset: While we don't expect you to check every box, a passion for learning and self-improvement is highly valued.

Must have for the application

* A portfolio featuring examples of your design work and problem-solving skills.

Let’s talk money

* A salary adequate to your experience and skills.  
* Flexible remuneration and benefits system via [Flexoh](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fflexoh%2Ecom%2F&urlhash=A-Ho&isSdui=true), which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.

True flexibility and work-life balance

* Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.  
* Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).  
* Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).  
* 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.  
* Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

* Private healthcare plan with [Adeslas](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esegurcaixaadeslas%2Ees%2Fen%2Fparticulares&urlhash=4msf&isSdui=true) for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).  
* Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with [Andjoy](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eandjoy%2Elife%2Fen&urlhash=4WPO&isSdui=true).  
* Access to [iFeel](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fifeelonline%2Ecom%2F&urlhash=g81m&isSdui=true), a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

* Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi\!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

## About the job

Who We Are  
At Balance (findbalance.app), we're building the clinical operating system for obesity treatment — combining medical rigor, AI intelligence, and multidisciplinary care teams to deliver personalized treatment at scale.   
In Spain alone, 200,000 people on GLP-1 medications today will grow to 1.2 million by 2030, most without access to proper clinical support.  We're fixing that.  We've proven our approach works and we have just closed our Seed Series funding.  Join us if you're obsessed with outcomes, not vanity metrics — and ready to help thousands of patients actually see results and feel better.  
About the role  
We're looking for a generalist, comfortable wearing many hats (UX, UI, research, sometimes frontend coding). We need a strong product thinker, focused on user needs and business metrics over pure visual aesthetics. You must be someone who can do (design with full autonomy as an individual contributor) and think (raise the bar for the entire design function). Someone who understands that UX in healthcare isn't just usability — it's adherence, trust, and behavior change.  
What you will do  
As an individual contributor:

* Design flows, screens, and interactions for the patient app and clinical dashboard, from discovery through delivery  
* Translate clinical and product requirements into clear, empathetic, and usable experiences  
* Maintain high design quality in a fast-iteration environment

As a leader:

* Collaborate across mixed profiles (product, clinical, marketing, engineering, partners)  
* Facilitate co-design sessions and workshops with stakeholders across the company  
* Be the design voice in cross-functional conversations  
* Take strategic, end-to-end ownership of the design process and actively set up the foundation for future design hiring

As a design system owner:

* Establish design principles and standards the team can apply independently  
* Lead the design and maintenance of our design system — components, tokens, documentation, governance  
* Identify and prioritize systemic usability and visual quality improvements across the platform

As a fervent patients’ advocate:

* Professionalize our research function: methodologies, cadence, synthesis, and connection to product decisions  
* Conduct interviews, usability tests, and contextual studies with patients and the clinical team  
* Build an insights repository that continuously feeds the roadmap

What we're looking for  
Must-haves:

* 5+ years of UX/product design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end work  
* Demonstrated ability to link design decisions directly to measurable business or clinical outcomes (e.g., adherence rates, conversion, retention).  
* Experience building or evolving a design system in production  
* Strong command of Figma and prototyping and user testing tools  
* Real familiarity with AI-assisted workflows — generative tools, accelerated prototyping, or integrating language models into design processes  
* Native or fluent Spanish; professional-level English — we read, write, and debate in both languages

Nice-to-haves:

* Ability to conduct research rigorously and connect findings to product decisions  
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS/modern frontend concepts for effective communication with engineers  
* Experience in service design or complex multi-actor systems like 2-sided marketplaces  
* Experience mentoring or managing people (even informally)  
* Prior work in health, wellness, or behavior change products  
* Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design

What we offer

* Competitive salary based on experience  
* Work hybridly from our Madrid offices or remotely from anywhere in Spain  
* Impact since day one: the work you do here shapes the experience of thousands of patients  
* Solve a real problem with real consequences: obesity is the most underestimated epidemic of our time  
* Genuine autonomy and ownership — no layers of design bureaucracy   
* A team that believes design isn't decoration but a clinical and competitive advantage  
* Opportunity to adopt frontier AI on internal workflows and patient-facing features

## About the job

Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year-on-year. And, we’re still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people’s everyday lives.

We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to help make great iOS and Android apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers\!

In this role you’ll;

* Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature.  
* Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma).  
* Craft user research plans and work directly with our product operations analysts/user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.  
* Contribute to Wave’s design system and component library.  
* Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.  
* Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions.  
* Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution.

Key details

* This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.  
* You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you’ll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You’re highly encouraged to visit market counties more often\! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year.  
* Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula, paid in your local currency equivalent plus a generous equity package. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to 216,900 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package.  
* Major benefits:  
  * Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).  
  * 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.  
  * Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.  
  * $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

* Fluency in English.  
* At least 8 years of end-to-end in-house experience, preferably with a consumer focus product design with mobile apps.  
* Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with an eye at removing friction from flows.  
* Attention to detail and high level of visual craft.  
* Strong illustration and animation skills. We use After Effects at Wave but anything that can be converted to a Lottie file works.  
* Ability to deliver high-quality designs with speed and polish.  
* Bias towards action. Identify UX improvements without waiting for the perfect conditions.  
* Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping.  
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  
* Ability to think through complex interaction design as well as thinking about tradeoffs of each solution.  
* Curiosity for understanding and unpacking customer behaviors and needs.  
* Experience balancing business goals, customer needs, and technical tradeoffs, while explaining your point of view to the team.

You might be a good fit if you

* Are detail-oriented and able to balance multiple projects.  
* Can iterate separate concepts quickly to user test design bets. The ability to move fast and update designs based on customer feedback is an important quality we’re looking for.  
* Think carefully about in-the-weeds details and their role within the design system.  
* Feel comfortable anticipating and designing for edge cases.  
* Enjoy pairing with designers, engineers, and product managers.  
* Are excited to learn about how all our products work together.  
* Can speak, read, and write in French. This is nice to have but not a strong requirement \- we have large markets in West Africa where French will come in handy. There are plenty of folks at Wave who do not speak/read/write in French and still do well :)

Our team

* We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.  
* We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.  
* We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.  
* We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021\. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.  
* We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue .

How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

## Construyendo el producto adecuado

### 1\. Investigamos

En Garaje de Ideas cubrimos todo el proceso de construcción de productos y servicios: desde la definición estratégica alineada con los objetivos de negocio y la propuesta de valor, pasando por la conceptualización, hasta la implementación de la solución.  
‍

### 2\. Conceptualizamos

Traducimos ideas en resultados, resolviendo los desafíos estratégicos de las organizaciones, tanto en la propuesta de valor (negocio), la estructura y capacidades de la empresa (tecnología) y la experiencia del cliente (usuarios).

### 3\. Prototipamos

Diseñamos con un enfoque en el detalle y la excelencia para asegurar la entrega de un producto final de calidad que supere expectativas. En Garaje, siempre buscamos el equilibrio entre funcionalidad, accesibilidad, usabilidad y estética.

## About the job

Who we are  
Quantion is a Business Digital Transformation services company founded in 2015 and part of the Astek Group group operating in more than 25 countries with over 10,000 employees worldwide.  
Our team is specialized in application development, UX/UI, and digital business transformation, focused on building innovative solutions that drive measurable business results.  
We combine our teams in cutting-edge technologies and digital deep experiences with the innovation ecosystem, to ensure that we can provide the best solution to face business challenges, from its concept to its implementation.  
We are looking for a UX/UI Desinger to join our Technology Team. If you want to participate in one of our biggest International projects, don’t hesitate to apply\!  
Required skills:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional education in user experience, media design, human computer interaction, interface or interaction design  
* Expert knowhow on digital content (online readability, conciseness, graphical elements, SEO, WCAG)  
* Expert understanding of user centricity, target groups, user scenarios, user dialogues  
* High analytical skills to model user and information flows improving digital sales experience  
* Advanced in prototyping and related tools; good understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design and working in CMS with templates is a plus  
* Experience in digital sales, marketing, IT, and/or relevant aviation fields is an advantage  
* Comfortable and competent to align user centered thinking in an agile working environment  
* Flexible to work on different digital B2C initiatives in a team and independently  
* Frustration tolerant, constructive and searching for ways to move forward  
* Very good communication skills towards cross functional teams and stakeholders  
* Fluent in English. German is a plus

Apply to our offer…  
🚀 You will grow professionally in a company in constant development and evolution.  
📏 You will benefit from a personalized follow-up of your professional projects as close as possible to your ambitions.  
📈 You will make a real contribution to the company's development in real time.  
🏝️ You will enjoy 23 days of vacation  
🌍 You will join our team: diverse, multicultural and constantly growing.  
🔋 You will have days full of good energy and good atmosphere.

## About the job

*Davidson Consulting España nace en el año 2014\. Formamos parte del grupo Davidson, multinacional francesa de servicios tecnológicos con \+18 años de experiencia en el sector y presencia en varios países europeos además de en Canadá. Somos 3000 compañeros a nivel global.*  
*En España nos caracterizamos por ser un equipo de más de 150 profesionales altamente cualificados y apasionados por el mundo de la tecnología y la innovación. Por ello, nuestro objetivo es seguir aumentando el equipo para continuar involucrados en proyectos nacionales e internacionales de gran envergadura.*  
Desde Davidson buscamos un/a Diseñador UX/UI, para unirse a nuestro equipo en España para un importante proyecto en una multinacional muy importante en su sector para desarrollar nuevos productos de Inteligencia de Negocios (Business Intelligence) y Datos centrado en aplicaciones de escritorio y móviles con un alto uso de datos, paneles (dashboards) e inteligencia artificial.  
Funciones:  
1.Estrategia y diseño UX:

* Diseñar interfaces intuitivas y centradas en el usuario para paneles e instrumentos de BI que simplifiquen el análisis de datos y mejoren la toma de decisiones del usuario.  
* Desarrollar wireframes, prototipos y flujos de usuario para comunicar claramente las ideas de diseño a los interesados.  
* Garantizar la coherencia del diseño entre los diferentes paneles, plataformas y con las directrices del cliente.

2.Visualización de datos:

* Crear indicadores clave (KPI), gráficos y tablas claras que permitan a los usuarios interpretar fácilmente grandes volúmenes de datos.  
* Diseñar paneles que ayuden a los profesionales del sector de viajes a seguir KPIs, tendencias y previsiones.

3.Investigación y análisis de usuarios:

* Realizar investigaciones de usuarios con los PMs (product managers) para comprender sus necesidades, puntos de dolor y comportamientos en la industria del turismo.  
* Analizar los requisitos de los usuarios para herramientas de BI, incluyendo visualización de datos, informes y necesidades analíticas.

4.Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con gestores de producto, científicos de datos y desarrolladores para iterar los diseños y asegurar una implementación fluida.  
Requisitos mínimos del puesto:

* \+ de 2 años de experiencia como Diseñador UX/UI.  
* Experiencia en: FIGMA,REACT, Data Visualization, Wireframing And Prototyping, HIGHCHARTS.  
* Formación reglada en Informática y/o diseño gráfico.  
* Valorable inglés fluido.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

* Modelo de trabajo híbrido. Lugar de residencia Madrid.  
* Contratación indefinida.  
* Salario competitivo según valía y experiencia aportada.  
* Plan de carrera y desarrollo profesional.

*¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?*  
*Nos caracterizamos por el excelente trato a los compañeros y una estructura organizativa horizontal. Te sentirás arropado y como en casa, tu opinión siempre importa. Contarás con oportunidades reales de crecimiento y proyección.*  
*Si estás interesad@ en participar en el proceso de selección o simplemente quieres conocer más sobre estas oportunidades, ¡no dudes en postularte a la oferta\!*

## About the job

🎯 ¡Estamos buscando un/a UX/UI Designer con disponibilidad inmediata\!  
En @GeneralSoftware , nos encontramos en plena expansión y buscamos un/a UX/UI Designer con visión estratégica, sensibilidad por la experiencia del usuario y experiencia real en el sector bancario, para sumarse a un proyecto de innovación digital de alto impacto.  
🧠 ¿Qué harás?

* Facilitar workshops de co-creación, ideación y descubrimiento con stakeholders y usuarios.  
* Aplicar metodologías centradas en el usuario: investigación, user personas, journey maps, prototipos y pruebas de usabilidad.  
* Diseñar interfaces intuitivas, accesibles y alineadas a estándares del sector bancario.

* 💬 Cultura abierta al feedback, la mejora continua y el trabajo en equipo.  
* 💰 Remuneración competitiva acorde a experiencia y perfil.

## About the job

The company specializes in the design, production, and installation of a diverse range of premium interior doors, exterior doors, and closets, meticulously designed and produced for the UAE customer, in the UAE. Empowered by our state-of-the-art, in-house computerized design and production facilities. Our approach seamlessly blends cutting-edge technology with expert craftsmanship to deliver solutions that surpass expectations. The company is diversified enterprise specializing in commercial construction solutions, with particular expertise in premium doors, closets, wall fits and architectural products. It emphasizes the company's technical expertise, quality assurance practices, and commitment to customer service excellence.  
Role Description  
This is a full-time remote role for a UI/UX Designer. The UI/UX Designer will be responsible for creating mockups, visual design, prototyping, front-end development, and user experience design (UED) on a day-to-day basis.  
Qualifications

* Mockups, Visual Design, and Prototyping skills  
* Front-End Development and User Experience Design (UED) skills  
* Designs intuitive interfaces for non-technical users.  
* Experience in designing user interfaces for web and mobile applications  
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, or other design tools  
* Understanding of responsive design and usability principles  
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills  
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities  
* Bachelor's degree in Design, or related field

## About the job

🔹 Opportunity at Capitole – Senior UX Designer 🔹  
Position Description  
At Capitole, we are looking for a Senior UX Designer to join an international team on a large-scale digital transformation project.  
This role is ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in product design and a proven track record working with global, well-known clients.  
Key Responsibilities  
🔹 Design innovative, intuitive, and visually compelling solutions for complex web applications  
🔹 Collaborate with international stakeholders from product, engineering, and design  
🔹 Translate requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs  
🔹 Conduct and apply user research insights to guide design decisions  
🔹 Contribute to and maintain scalable design systems  
🔹 Mentor and support other designers in the team  
Must Have  
🔹*Solid* understanding of responsive design and basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JS  
🔹 5+ years of experience as a UX Designer in SaaS Products (Payroll, ERP...)  
🔹 Previous experience working with global, enterprise-level clients (mandatory)  
🔹 Proficiency in tools like Figma and Miro  
🔹 Professional proficiency in English  
💙 Why join us?  
📘 €1,200 per year in training  
🏥 Free private health insurance  
🔹 Flexible compensation on transport, childcare, and meal vouchers  
🏋️‍♂️ Access to 10K+ gyms across Spain via Wellhub (Gymforless)  
🎉 Events, team buildings, and afterworks every two months  
⚽ We sponsor our own football team – join if you’re up for it\!  
🔧 Internal tech communities to learn, share, and grow

About the job

Your new team 

We are a medium-sized, globally distributed design team headed by Benny Zuffolini, Kyrsten McCartney, Jag Rai, and Catherine Stuart, and we are dedicated to the Language Learning sector of Pearson, with its multiple product families and diverse audience. We work across UX/UI Design, UX Writing, UX Research, and Service Design. 

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, cultures, seniorities and neurotypes, which creates a dynamic environment with opportunities for growth. While we are spread across different geographies, we primarily collaborate with stakeholders in European time zones. 

The UX discipline at Pearson follows simple principles: One size does not fit all, It is all about our users. Keep it simple and consistent, reuse don’t reinvent. 

In addition, our team strongly values Collaboration, Curiosity, Proactivity and Making an Impact both in our work and in how we relate to our colleagues. We work together, we learn from everyone’s uniqueness, and we focus on adding value for our users while working towards the company’s goals. 

 

The skills you will need in your new role 

You'll collaborate daily with product managers, researchers, engineers, and QA in an agile environment to deliver user-centric solutions. You'll take part in the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and prototyping to testing and implementation ensuring accessible and seamless user experiences. The key skills required include: 

 • Translating product briefs into tangible artefacts: Ability to create user flows, wireframes, prototypes and anything that can help the cross-functional team understand the user perspective and think a few steps ahead. 

• Strong UI and interaction design skills: Ability to design both static and dynamic components to enhance user engagement and usability. 

 • Responsive design skills: Experience designing responsive web layouts across various screen sizes. App design experience is a plus. 

• Knowledge of Design Systems: Familiarity with design systems, with the ability to contribute new components and maintain consistency across products. 

• Proficiency in Figma: Expert in using Figma for design, prototyping, and design team collaboration. 

• Ability to translate research into actionable insights: Skilled in interpreting UX research and analytics to inform and refine design solutions. Ability to usability-test your own designs. 

• Adaptability: You know how to put the product and users above your own biases and be open to feedback and iterative design processes. 

• Collaboration: You will work seamlessly with other designers and cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and marketers. A bonus would be experience of running workshops. 

 

What to expect from this process 

 In order to apply, you’ll need to send us your CV and Portfolio (online or PDF, your choice\!). 

Our interview process is made of 4 steps: 

Portfolio Review (45 mins) 

Values & Team (30 mins) 

Cross-functional Interview (30 mins) 

Bar Raiser (30 mins) 

After each step, if both you and us consider the interview successful, an invitation to the next step is sent out.

## About the job

¿POR QUÉ ELEGIR SNGULAR?  
La gente viene a SNGULAR atraída por proyectos que usan tecnologías punteras, y se quedan por los grandes profesionales con los que trabajan. Y además porque ofrecemos esto:  
🙋 ♂️Personas primero: somos una empresa colaborativa orientada a las personas, donde TÚ y tu perspectiva siempre serán valoradas. Nuestro valor número uno es "Personas antes que resultados". ¿Suena bonito? Pues en SNGULAR, además, lo llevamos a la práctica.  
📈 Crecimiento y formación continua: Tenemos un espíritu de Start-up con la infraestructura de una gran organización (ya somos 1300). Se te ofrecerán oportunidades de crecimiento profesional: aprender nuevas habilidades, obtener nuevas certificaciones, o convertirte en un gran Líder... ¡deja tu zona de confort de la manera que TÚ quieras\!  
🏋️ ♀️ Beneficios increíbles (los tienes detallados al final), tenemos incluso un Wellbeing Pack para cuidar nuestro bienestar físico y mental.  
En SNGULAR adoptamos una cultura plural, donde trabajamos con respeto, donde existe igualdad de oportunidades, donde nos enorgullecemos de ser proactivos, trabajamos con humildad e intentamos mantener siempre un espíritu de equipo, sin perder nunca el buen humor.  
Conoce todo lo que hace de Sngular un \#BestPlaceToGrow  
¿CUÁL SERÁ TU ROL?  
Especialista de UX/UI para unirse a nuestro equipo y trabajar en distintos proyectos o clientes ya que tenemos varias oportunidades abiertas en el sector moda, financiero, retail y energía.

* Idear, estructurar, crear prototipos y diseñar soluciones.  
* Analizar, mapear y diseñar flujos de usuarios.  
* Crear especificaciones de requisitos funcionales.  
* Ofrecer soluciones multiplataforma de interfaz y diseño de interacción (Desktop,Tablet y Mobile).  
* Diseñar interfaces visualmente atractivas que respeten la marca y personalidad del cliente.  
* Apoyar en proyectos de forma autónoma.

¿QUÉ SE NECESITA PARA ESTA POSICIÓN?

* Conocimientos de prototipado y herramientas de diseño.  
* Experiencia de al menos 2 años.  
* Experiencia en la creación de soluciones multiplataforma para diferentes dispositivos.  
* Herramientas de Prototipado, Wireframing o Diseño Visual: Figma  
* Experiencia en proyectos usando (no construyendo) sistemas de diseño.  
* Valorable herramientas de Mapeo de Experiencia de Usuario: Customer journey maps, Mapas de empatía., Diagramas de flujo.  
* Inglés alto es fundamental (B2+)  
* Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y en equipos multidisciplinarios.  
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para colaborar con diferentes equipos.

Perks (beneficios)  
👨 🎓 Acceso a formación continua: presupuesto individual para formación, obtención de certificaciones, acceso ilimitado a Udemy, clases de idiomas, dinámicas de formación interna.  
🏠 Flexibilidad horaria, teletrabajo, posibilidad de trabajar desde nuestros Hubs.  
📅 22 días de vacaciones \+ día de cumpleaños \+ 2 días de asistencia a eventos técnicos \+ 24 y 31 de diciembre no laborables.  
🌞 Wellbeing pack: Ayuda para la mejora del bienestar.  
💵 Retribución flexible.  
🎉 Dinámicas y Eventos de Teambuilding  
🎁 Pack de Bienvenida  
💻 Posibilidad de elegir equipo (Windows / Mac)  
🚀 Otras Iniciativas que te permiten conseguir bonus adicionales: recomendar profesionales, speaker en eventos, artículos técnicos,...  
And last, but not least: ¡porque somos muy Sngulares\!💙 Tenemos Encuentro Virtual todos los viernes, fiestas, espacios donde podrás expresarte, proponer cambios y ser partícipe de ellos.

## About the job

TLDR; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it: https://hsptb.com/hndbk We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together.

Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help them with more of their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself: https://hsptb.com/twnhll

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones, not countries.

What you will be working on:

As Staff Product Designer, you are destroying complexity as an art form.

You will be responsible for leading the design of our platform, ensuring that every interaction is intuitive, every screen is elegant, and every feature is a joy to use. You will play a critical role in shaping the product's direction, working closely with leadership, and our product and engineering teams to bring your designs to life.

To accomplish this, you will:

* Lead the design process from concept to execution, including user research, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, and interaction design  
* Develop and maintain a consistent design language and style guide that reflects our brand and product vision  
* Leverage data, user feedback, and research to refine the user journey  
* Drive the overall design vision for the product, aligned with the company's long-term strategy and values  
* Inspire the team with innovative ideas and a commitment to creating a product that users love and remember

Requirements Hospitable.com is a remote-only and distributed company. Your location is not a requirement for this position. The ideal fit would work in a European or American (up to East Coast) timezone.

What we are looking for:

* Leadership: Proven ability to lead design projects and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.  
* Experience: Rather than years, very senior experience in UI/UX design for a SaaS product, with a world-class portfolio demonstrating your ability to create delightful, intuitive, and fluid experiences  
* Skills: You live and breathe in design tools. Nothing exotic: we use Whimsical for mockups, Figma for designs  
* Creativity: Ability to think outside the box and push conventional design to create something truly differentiated  
* Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts and decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders  
* Passion: A deep passion for design, a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of what makes a product truly exceptional.  
* Attention to detail, keeping in mind that Bobby's favourite ice cream flavour is Salted Butter Caramel  
* Very special kudos if you are a short-term rental/Airbnb host or have been working in a short-term rental business  
* Everything else is a lovely bonus that we're excited to hear about\!

Benefits The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

* A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output  
* The total cash budget for this role is between USD $148,000.00 (Senior I) to $206,800.00 (Staff I) depending on seniority and the cost of living in your location. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. The gross salary for US employees could be anywhere between $136,551.16 to $190,802.56  
* We also offer compensation into the company equity through our $HOST Token (RSU's), with a grant value of up to $75,200, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.  
* Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional $459,816.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.  
* For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k)  
* 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave  
* Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill  
* Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards

# Lead Product Designer \- AirHelp Mobile App

HybridProductFull time

Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain

Berlin, Berlin, Germany

Gdańsk, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

Kraków, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

Warsaw, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland  
[Overview](https://apply.workable.com/airhelp/j/6B5964DFBA/)[Application](https://apply.workable.com/airhelp/j/6B5964DFBA/apply/)

## Description

The AirHelp mobile app is a travel companion that helps users track their flights in real time, stay informed about disruptions, and take action instantly when something happens. From live flight tracking and smart notifications to seamless claim submission and status tracking, the app removes the complexity from air travel and passenger rights \- We’re evolving the app into a proactive, intelligent travel assistant \- one that not only reacts to disruptions, but anticipates them, guides users in real time, and becomes a product people rely on every time they travel.

With nearly one million downloads in under eight months and strong engagement beyond projections, we’ve validated the need. Now the challenge is to turn this into a category-defining mobile experience.

We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to own this journey \- defining how the product works, how it evolves, and how it delivers meaningful value to millions of travellers. You’ll work closely with product and engineering tribes to define problems, form hypotheses, build and test solutions, and continuously improve the product based on real user behavior. You will lead mobile design while helping the team operate with more speed, clarity, and impact.

This role is based in one of our offices: Barcelona, Berlin, Kraków, Warszawa or Gdańsk. We work in a hybrid setup (2 days/week in the office).

### What You’ll Drive:

* Own AirHelp mobile app product design end-to-end, from problem definition through shipped outcomes and iteration.  
* Operate with a hypothesis-driven mindset. Frame problems clearly, align quickly, and move fast into testing and learning.   
* Prototype early using AI tools (Cursor, Claude), building real flows instead of static mocks. Treat prototypes as the starting point for production.  
* Validate through real usage. Talk to users, run quick tests, and use data to continuously adjust direction.  
* Translate validated ideas into production-ready design, with strong attention to clarity, edge cases, and system alignment.  
* Balance speed and craft. Move quickly to explore, then refine in Figma to deliver polished, scalable solutions.  
* Own both day-to-day improvements and larger strategic initiatives, balancing priorities based on evolving business needs.  
* Contribute to product strategy by identifying opportunities and leading initiatives from concept to execution..  
* Raise the bar for design through systems thinking, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

### What you will deliver in your first 12 months: 

* Redesign and optimize core app architecture and key flows to significantly increase engagement during the day-of-flight experience.  
* Drive meaningful post-flight engagement by introducing high-value follow-ups that extend the user relationship beyond a single trip.  
* Increase organic growth by making the app inherently shareable at key travel moments, turning users into distribution.  
* Improve re-engagement by building habits and triggers that bring users back for their next trip, not just their current one.

### What sets you apart:

* You operate at the intersection of product thinking and design leadership, bringing a clear point of view and the ability to influence direction, not just execute it.  
* You’ve built and shipped mobile products end-to-end, and you understand what great mobile UX looks like from first interaction to long-term engagement. You know how to scale quality through strong design systems.  
* You think like a product leader. You focus on the right problems, connect user needs with business impact, and make decisions that move the product forward, not just make it look better.  
* You’re comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You take ownership and don’t wait for perfect clarity \- you create it.   
* You work fast and pragmatically. You use tools like AI to explore ideas, validate directions, and accelerate your workflow. You know when to go deep in Figma and when to move on.  
* You’re an exceptional communicator. You align teams, influence stakeholders, and articulate product thinking in a way that drives decisions and builds trust.  
* You collaborate closely with engineers \- including distributed or external teams \- and understand what it takes to turn ideas into production-ready solutions.  
* You have a high bar for quality, but also strong judgment. You know when to refine and when to ship.  
* You’re fluent in business English

### Why AirHelp?

* Culture of Autonomy: No micromanagement, no politics. Just builders building.  
* Growth Investment: Personal development plans, internal workshops, mentorship, and language classes.  
* Culture That Cares: Team events, supportive peers, and a mission you can feel proud of.  
* Flexible Benefits: Choose between gym pass, personal development, childcare, transport, or travel subsidies.  
* Global Workstyle: Work from anywhere for up to 2 weeks/year, because we know the best ideas come from seeing the world.

[Overview](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/duck-duck-go/776bd1c8-81aa-4719-8238-ba357e1f5271?utm_source=pbMkGlP0lv)[Application](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/duck-duck-go/776bd1c8-81aa-4719-8238-ba357e1f5271/application?utm_source=pbMkGlP0lv)

# Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on [Mac](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/), [Windows](https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/), [iOS](https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/), and [Android](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/), our [search engine](https://duckduckgo.com/), and the latest — [Privacy Pro](https://spreadprivacy.com/meetprivacypro/). Our [culture](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work) of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place\!

# Your Team and Role

In this role, you will collaborate with team members at all levels to identify and solve problems across our current product offering, as well as helping to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the Internet. You'll have the opportunity to level up our products through exploring and testing concepts that improve overall experience and increase delight while appealing to a broader audience.

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: [https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/](https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/)

# About You

* 6+ years of experience in product design roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands.  
* Proficiency in managing projects of varying complexity, from proposal, through execution and release, all while working transparently and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and contributors.  
* A knack for pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality.  
* Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale.  
* Accustomed to applying agentic solutions into every day project management and design execution workflows to both accelerate and raise the quality of your work.  
* Ability to write creative briefs that clearly define and communicate project goals, rationale, and success metrics with stakeholders.  
* Proficiency in research and experimentation — you can leverage both qualitative and quantitative data in driving decisions forward.  
* Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics.  
* Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively.  
* A willingness to apply your experience and expertise in educating, guiding, and supporting others, while serving as a steward to maintain quality of execution across designated areas of design.  
* Experience participating in multiple areas of the product process including prioritization, strategy, and user testing.

# Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is [identical within professional levels](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work), regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our [Team Member Support Guide](https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf) explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

# Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about [how we hire](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire).

# Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

# Please note that:

1. You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing  
2. Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.  
3. While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.  
4. A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.  
5. By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

# Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

1. Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our [Recruiting Privacy Policy](https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf). We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.  
2. Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.  
3. Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo\!

Our top goal as an employer is to bring together a diverse mix of talented people who are excited to join our company, stay with Terra for a long time, and do their best work while they’re here. We take pride in the quality of the services and work we provide to our clients, and we know none of it is possible without the hard work and commitment of our passionate and creative employees.

## About the job

UX Designer

📍 Barcelona, Spain | Hybrid (3 days onsite / 2 days remote)

We Are

Wizeline is a global AI-native technology solutions provider that develops cutting-edge, AI-powered digital products and platforms. We partner with clients to leverage data and AI, accelerating market entry and driving business transformation. As a global community of innovators, we foster a culture of growth, collaboration, and impact.

With the right people and the right ideas, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

Are you a fit?

Sounds awesome, right? Now, let’s make sure you’re a good fit for the role.

We’re looking for a UX Designer who can craft thoughtful, user-centered experiences while balancing product goals and real-world constraints. In this role, you’ll design end-to-end experiences, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and bring structured design thinking to complex problems.

You will work closely with product managers, engineers, marketing teams, and researchers, helping translate business and user needs into intuitive digital experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong UX fundamentals, systems thinking, and excellent communication skills to clearly articulate the reasoning behind design decisions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design end-to-end user experiences, delivering clear and intuitive solutions across digital products.  
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and design frameworks that communicate ideas effectively.  
* Partner closely with product, engineering, research, and marketing teams to align design solutions with user needs and business goals.  
* Apply systems thinking to ensure consistency and scalability across product experiences.  
* Contribute to and help evolve design systems and shared design patterns.  
* Advocate for the user while balancing technical feasibility, product priorities, and business constraints.  
* Clearly communicate and present design decisions and rationale to stakeholders.  
* Collaborate in cross-functional environments and participate in design reviews, feedback sessions, and iteration cycles.

Must-have Skills

* Bachelor’s Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, or a related field.  
* 5+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, or Interaction Design.  
* Advanced English level (written and spoken) with strong presentation and communication skills.  
* A strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered design thinking, structured problem-solving, and clear design rationale.  
* Expertise in UX methodologies, including journey mapping, flow design, and interaction patterns.  
* Proficiency in Figma (or similar design tools) with strong attention to visual and interaction details.  
* Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, product, marketing, and research.  
* Ability to explain and advocate for design approaches to stakeholders, balancing design vision with product and business priorities.  
* Strong product mindset and business understanding to help prioritize design decisions.

Nice-to-have

* AI Tooling Proficiency: Leverage one or more AI tools to optimize and augment day-to-day work, including drafting, analysis, research, or process automation. Provide recommendations on effective AI use and identify opportunities to streamline workflows.  
* Experience working with or contributing to design systems.  
* Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design best practices.  
* Background in user research, content strategy, or service design.  
* Experience working within Agile product development environments.

What We Offer

* A High-Impact Environment  
* Commitment to Professional Development  
* Flexible and Collaborative Culture  
* Global Opportunities  
* A Vibrant Community  
* Total Rewards  
* Specific benefits are determined by the employment type and location.

Find out more about our culture [here](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Einstagram%2Ecom%2Fwizelineglobal%2F&urlhash=0-9d&isSdui=true).
