## About the job

One of our key areas is the Core UX & Mobile area, where we work on the foundations of the experience for our users across both mobile and web platforms. In this area, we define the core patterns and architecture that other teams build upon. It’s about setting the groundwork that ensures consistency, quality, and scalability across the product.  
We’re looking for a strong, talented Senior Designer who will play a key role in this area and take ownership of it. This role involves close collaboration with multiple teams and requires someone who can confidently influence, and drive foundational experience decisions across the organization.  
Your responsibilities will include fostering innovation and working closely with diverse teams to ensure an outstanding user experience.  
Core UX & Mobile @PandaDoc

* Develop Information Architecture: Design and evolve the overall information architecture of the application, ensuring clarity, logical structure, and seamless navigation across the entire product ecosystem.  
* Build Cross-Platform Foundations: Work across both web and mobile platforms to create consistent, scalable experience patterns that adapt to the specifics of each platform while maintaining a unified product vision.  
* Establish Core Experience Patterns: Define reusable UX patterns and structural frameworks that serve as the foundation for other teams, enabling them to build features on top of a coherent and well-designed base.  
* Collaborate with the Design System Team: Partner closely with the design system to ensure scalability, consistency, and technical feasibility, so that solutions are reusable and easy for other designers and engineers to adopt.  
* Enable Scalable Product Evolution: Create a flexible experience framework that allows other teams to layer their solutions efficiently, supporting long-term product growth without fragmenting the user experience.

Role responsibilities:

* End-to-end Process: Independently manage full design cycles, from research through to implementation. Demonstrate a solid understanding of user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.  
* Design Execution: Craft user journeys aligned with product behavior, user needs, and workflows. Proficient in prototyping, uses design system components and meaningful data to validate both physical and digital interactions.  
* Research: Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research to gather insights and refine design hypotheses. Iterate designs based on user feedback and research findings to continuously improve the product experience and validate design solutions.  
* Design System: Collaborate with the design system team and developers to implement improvements. Identify potential issues in components and the contribution process.  
* Collaboration: Proactively communicate changes, project progress, updates, project notes, strategic thoughts, etc. to managers, key stakeholders, and peers. Ensuring visual and functional consistency across all product.  
* Advocacy: Promote design principles and user-centered design philosophy across the organization.  
* Usability and accessibility: Champion usability and accessibility principles to create intuitive and accessible user experiences. Refine user journeys and interactions to simplify complex workflows and enhance user satisfaction.

Your core competencies:

* Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in interaction design, visual design, information architecture, and design systems. Proven track record in designing sophisticated software products that prioritize intuitive user experiences.  
* Expertise: Deep understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, and accessibility standards. Understanding of user psychology and human-centered design principles. Bonus points if you have experience in document lifecycle management software.  
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in design tools (e.g., Figma, Framer, Adobe Creative Suite) and a strong understanding of front-end and AI technologies.  
* Research: Demonstrated ability to deeply understand user needs through integrating user research into the design process. Proficient in gathering and utilizing both qualitative and quantitative user research to drive informed design decisions.  
* Communication: Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. Excellent verbal and written communication skills (B2 in English), with the ability to articulate complex design concepts clearly to diverse audiences.  
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving design issues.

Our tech stack:

* Figma for craft and store design component library  
* Coda/GoogleDocs for our internal kitchen: processes, checklists, playbooks, etc.  
* Slack and Zoom for communication  
* FigJam for collaboration  
* Zeroheight for design documentation  
* Amplitude, Uservoice, Rally, Maze and more for listening our users  
* Anything, you think would be valuable for us, can be tested

Company Overview:   
PandaDoc empowers more than 67,000 growing organizations to thrive by taking the work out of document workflow. PandaDoc provides an all-in-one document workflow automation platform that helps fast scaling teams accelerate the ability to create, manage, and sign digital documents including proposals, quotes, contracts, and more.  For more information, please visit [https://www.pandadoc.com](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Epandadoc%2Ecom%2F&urlhash=ZrUy&isSdui=true).  
Company Culture:   
We're known for our work-life balance, kind co-workers, & creative virtual team-bonding events. And although our Pandas are located across the globe, we stay connected with the help of technology and ensure that everyone on our team feels, well, like a team.  
Pandas work best when they're happy. We retain our talent by upholding our values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of our customers.   
Check out our [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pandadoc/life/pdcompanyculture/) to learn more.  
Benefits:

* A competitive salary. If you are located in Poland, the salary range is 222000 to 334000 PLN annually.  
* An honest, open culture that emphasizes feedback and promotes professional and personal development  
* An opportunity to work from anywhere — our team is distributed worldwide, from Lisbon to Manila, from Florida to California  
* 6 self care days  
* And much more\!

PandaDoc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal treatment of all employees without regard to race, national origin, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, physical or mental disability or other basis protected by law.

## About the job

*“Men wanted for hazardous journey. Low wages, bitter cold, long months of complete darkness, constant danger. Safe return doubtful. Honour and recognition in case of success.”*  
*Sir Ernest Shackleton \- Antarctic explorer*  
Meet the team\!  
We are Modelia.  
We are building the platform that will transform how the fashion industry creates, manages, and scales visual content. For decades, brands have relied on photoshoots as the foundation of their visual production. They are expensive, slow, and deeply embedded in every P\&L.  
We believe that model is coming to an end.  
Modelia replaces photoshoots with a software-first approach. A single product image becomes the starting point for generating complete visual assets across eCommerce, marketing, and campaigns. What used to require studios, logistics, and large production teams can now be created, iterated, and scaled instantly.  
This is not a feature. It is a shift in how an entire industry operates.  
Our ambition is to become the platform fashion brands rely on globally to produce visuals, removing photoshoots from their workflows and from their cost structure altogether.  
We are a small, focused team, moving fast, building something that doesn’t have a clear precedent.  
The Role  
This is the most important hire we will make this year: You will own how Modelia feels.  
Not just how it looks, but how it behaves. How users understand it. How complexity is turned into something that feels obvious. Our product is powerful, but not yet simple. That is the work.  
You will work on real problems coming from real users. We see where people struggle. We see where they hesitate, where they get lost, where they drop off. You will take that friction and turn it into clarity.  
You will design new capabilities end to end, from the first idea to what actually ships. You will make decisions that define how users interact with AI systems that don’t yet have established patterns.  
You will work closely with engineering to ensure what is designed is actually built well. There is no separation between thinking and execution here.  
If you enjoy taking something complex and making it feel inevitable, this role will fit.  
What we are looking for

* You have real experience building complex products where UX is not obvious and requires judgment.  
* You’ve spent years designing systems, not just screens. You know how to structure information, define interactions, and bring coherence to products that grow fast and become messy.  
* You have a portfolio that shows how you think. Not just outcomes, but how you got there, what you considered, and why you made the decisions you made.  
* You are comfortable working closely with engineers and understand what it takes to move from idea to production without losing intent.  
* You use user feedback and product data as inputs, not as instructions. You can interpret what you see and turn it into clear design direction.  
* You care about quality and details, but you don’t hide behind perfection. You move fast, make decisions, and improve continuously.  
* Clear communication in English is required. We work asynchronously across teams and timezones.

You'll have an edge if you bring

* Experience designing for fashion eCommerce, AI tooling, or visual generation products (Midjourney style, Photoshop, Figma itself, Canva, Runway, etc.)  
* Past work on enterprise grade SaaS with team and seat models, role based access, and admin surfaces.  
* Comfort with motion design, and a clear sense of how a hover, a loading state, or a transition can carry meaning.

## About the job

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We are looking for a curious and skilled Product Designer whose main focus will be Observability. You’re a designer that is ready to take on advanced design challenges and help elevate our products’ user experience. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Senior Designers, and UX Researchers, to craft intuitive, research-driven solutions that align with Elastic’s vision.

This is not just a role; it’s a chance to grow your career while tackling some of the most meaningful problems in the industry\!

Applications without a link to a Portfolio or a Case Study will not be considered. We appreciate your understanding.

What You Will Be Doing:

* Partner closely with PMs, developers, and cross-functional teams to dig deep into user needs, shaping innovative solutions that resonate.  
* An opportunity to conduct user research activities such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, and data analysis to uncover user problems, behaviors, and motivations.  
* Synthesize research findings into actionable insights that guide the design process, ensuring our products meet real user needs.  
* Craft intuitive and engaging interaction designs that balance aesthetics and usability, ensuring seamless experiences across all touchpoints.  
* Bring user experiences to life at every stage—from early sketches to polished prototypes—using wireframes, flow diagrams, storyboards, mockups, and high-fidelity designs.  
* Continuously evolve product experiences by blending user feedback with business insights, ensuring we deliver significant improvements.  
* Champion design-driven decisions that push for refinement, enhancement, and a user-first approach across the board.

What You Bring:

* 5+ years of proven experience in product design within a B2B-focused company, demonstrating growing confidence in designing complex features.  
* You can design user interfaces that are not only visually appealing but also highly functional and aligned with key business goals.  
* Experience addressing user-focused problems solved via creative UI solutions, design systems ([EUI](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=http%3A%2F%2Feui%2Eelastic%2Eco&urlhash=gkha&isSdui=true)) and quality assurances.  
* Proficiency with product design tools (we use Figma and Figjam)  
* Comfortable and confident in communicating and discussing design decisions  
* Eagerness to learn and grow, actively seeking feedback and mentoring from senior designers.  
* Stay current with the latest design and technology trends and adopt new techniques, as appropriate  
* Proactive communication: Ability to successfully communicate in a distributed team environment, using offline modes such as Slack, GitHub, and Google Docs.  
* Involvement in design projects and working as part of a team.

Bonus Points:

* Experience designing data-intensive user experiences  
* Experience contributing to an established design system  
* Experience designing automation or GenAI-powered products  
* Background in the Security and Cyber domain  
* Working on complex technical products  
* Knowledge of HTML and CSS

Additional Information \- We Take Care of Our People: As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary  
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations  
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles  
* Generous number of vacation days each year  
* Increase your impact \- We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service  
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love  
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Security & Privacy Responsibilities: Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.

## About the job

What will you be doing?  
Service Designers are responsible for the design of systems made of people, digital, and physical touchpoints. They orchestrate value exchanges among them in ways that make the system sustainable for both the users and providers.  
As a Service Designer II, you will sometimes be the only service design specialist on a program. You are expected to plan, prioritise, and deliver service design activities autonomously, in the context of interdisciplinary projects. You will lead client conversations within your domain, providing articulate recommendations and helping guide client choices.  
Your fellow frogs will rely on you to:

* Drive the design of systemic interventions in complex, multi-partner ecosystems  
* Champion visual frameworks – like journey maps, service blueprints, ecosystem maps – that help bring clarity to complex challenges in human behaviours, relationships, workflow and processes, and drive decision making  
* Drive contribution and alignment from multiple stakeholders, whether clients, third-party or larger ecosystem player  
* Utilise experience prototyping techniques like desktop walkthrough and role playing that help test and validate service components and to convey value propositions  
* Advocate service providers as much as service users

On a typical project you will:

* Map existing service ecosystems and service delivery processes  
* Plan, conduct, and synthesise research with existing/potential service users and existing/potential service providers (front and back-end)  
* Identify frameworks best suited to project needs and emerging insights along the service delivery, for front and back-office processes (e.g., customer journeys, service blueprints, ecosystem maps) that include metrics to help monitor service performance through time  
* Orchestrate and lead co-creation workshops with clients, partners, and customers to drive the analysis of current services and the design of improved/new services  
* Frame and consolidate service value propositions for service users and service providers  
* Orchestrate service test sessions using prototyping tools and techniques (digital/physical mock-ups of touchpoints, service scripts, pilot protocols etc.) with users and providers to validate service components and define detailed service requirements  
* Support client organisations in the implementation of new services, co-organising employee trainings using service playbooks and simulations of detailed service processes

We want you to have:

* 2+ years of professional service design experience (although you might have a different job title, like “strategic designer” or “business designer”)  
* Highly developed design skills, demonstrated in your portfolio of recent work  
* Confident presentation and storytelling abilities  
* Experience collaborating in multifunctional teams  
* Proficiency with contemporary design and prototyping tools and methods  
* Affinity with frog’s values, and a passion for creating services that meet peoples functional and emotional needs  
* Experience in translate research insights into design artifacts such as wireframes, prototypes, and final visual designs.  
* Tools: Figma for design and prototyping, Dovetail for user research, Klaxoon for User Journey maps, Atlassian for collaboration  
* Business level ability in English

It would be a bonus if you had:

* A university degree in Service Design or a related design or business discipline  
* Experience working in a variety of organisations (start-up, corporate, agency/consultancy)  
* Academic, professional, or life experience from outside the design field that enriches your perspective as a designer

Application Instructions

* As part of your application, please include a link or PDF of your portfolio of recent work, highlighting your abilities and experience relevant to the role, with specific examples of how you work, think, collaborate, and contribute to great design outcomes. Please note that we are unable to accept any applications without a portfolio

## About the job

🚀 We’re hiring a Product Designer (Internal Tools / AI-driven environment)  
At Joppy, we’re helping one of our clients find a Product Designer to join a team that is redefining how internal tools are built in the proptech space, with a strong AI-first approach.  
They are building the future of property investment, making it as simple and accessible as stocks or ETFs. Backed by global investors and founded by top-tier consulting alumni, they are scaling fast.  
💡 What you’ll do  
You’ll join the team designing and evolving a core internal platform used daily by Ops, Wealth, and Revenue teams across multiple countries.  
This is not “cosmetic” product design—this is high-impact workflow and systems design for expert users.

* Lead end-to-end design of new features and product improvements  
* Design for expert users: speed, clarity, and frictionless workflows  
* Collaborate closely with engineers, PMs, and internal stakeholders  
* Conduct user research: shadowing, interviews, and usability testing  
* Own and evolve the Design System (tokens, components, consistency)  
* Contribute to product strategy, not just execution

🤖 How we work  
AI is a core part of how the team designs and builds products.  
You’ll actively use tools like Claude, Figma Make, Stitch, and Weave to:

* Generate early design drafts  
* Speed up iteration cycles  
* Structure flows and UX copy

The team is also exploring emerging AI-to-design workflows and automation opportunities.  
🎯 What we’re looking for

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer  
* Advanced Figma skills (components, variants, auto layout, prototyping)  
* Experience building and maintaining Design Systems and Design Tokens  
* Strong UX/UI and accessibility knowledge  
* Experience with complex internal tools or data-heavy dashboards (strong plus)  
* Product mindset focused on impact, not just aesthetics  
* Comfortable working in an international environment (English required)  
* Regular use of AI tools in your design workflow  
* Genuine curiosity about how AI is reshaping design

🌱 What you’ll get

* Fast-growing startup environment with global reach  
* Real ownership and impact from day one  
* Culture of learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement  
* Highly collaborative international team  
* Clear career growth opportunities as the company scales  
* Competitive compensation package

🤝 Values

* Believe: entrepreneurial spirit and passion  
* Connect: one-team mindset  
* Raise the bar: no mediocrity  
* Own it: full accountability  
* Deliver: measurable impact

🌍 Commitment to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued and encouraged.

**Do these values resonate with you? Keep reading\!**

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our Vistral Squad, the team that builds and evolves Vistral, PropHero's internal operations platform. Vistral is the backbone of our day to day operations: the tool our Ops, Wealth, and Revenue teams use to manage properties, track settlements, coordinate with partners, and execute across Spain, Ireland, Indonesia, and Australia.

Designing for internal tools is a distinct discipline. Your users are expert operators who live inside the product for hours every day. They need speed, clarity, and workflow efficiency above all else. A screen that eliminates 10 minutes of friction from a daily task is a bigger win than a beautiful one that slows people down.

You'll work in a team that embraces AI as a core part of the design and development process. That means using Claude, Stitch,Weave, Figma and Figma Make as everyday tools to move faster and more consistently not as a novelty, but as a genuine shift in how a product gets built. You'll collaborate with engineers, PMs, and the internal users themselves to ship real operational improvements.

**How you will shape Prophero:**

* Lead end to end design of new features and improvements for Vistral, from concept (user flows, wireframes) to execution (high fidelity prototypes, production handoff).  
* Design for expert internal users (Ops, Wealth, Revenue teams): prioritise information density, workflow efficiency, and zero friction interactions over decorative polish.  
* Use AI tools (Claude, Figma Make, Stitch, Weave) as an integrated part of your daily workflow generating first-draft screens, structuring design briefs, and refining UX copy faster than traditional methods allow. You'll be supported with structured AI workflows already in place at PropHero.  
* Explore emerging AI to Figma workflows (such as programmatic design generation via API integrations) as the tooling matures; this is a genuine frontier and we expect you to be curious about it.  
* Collaborate closely with engineers, PMs, and the ops users themselves. You'll spend real time with the people using the tool, not just reading tickets.  
* Own and evolve our Design System, maintain Design Tokens, reusable components, and the Figma component kit that ensures consistency across Vistral as it scales.  
* Conduct qualitative research with internal users: workflow shadowing, usability tests, and process interviews to identify friction and validate design decisions.  
* Champion usability and accessibility as non-negotiables, even in internal tooling.  
* Contribute to product strategy not just executing, but shaping what Vistral becomes

**What you will bring to our team:**

* 3+ years of proven experience as a Product Designer in a digital product environment.  
* Advanced proficiency with Figma components, variants, auto layout, prototyping.  
* Proven experience creating and maintaining Design Systems with Design Tokens and reusable components.  
* Solid knowledge of UX/UI principles, accessibility standards , and responsive design.  
* Ability to plan, execute, and interpret user research.  
* Experience designing complex internal tools, dashboards, or data heavy interfaces is a strong plus.  
* Product mindset: you care about operational impact, not just aesthetics.  
* Intermediate to advanced English required to work with our international team.  
* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Gemini, or similar) as part of your daily design process for briefs, copy, flows, and iteration not occasionally, but routinely.  
* Experience with Figma Make or similar AI assisted design generation tools. You know how to write a brief that produces a useful output, and you know when to override the AI.  
* Genuine curiosity about how AI is reshaping the design profession. You're not waiting to see how this plays out, you're already experimenting.  
* Familiarity with agentic AI tools (Claude Code or similar) and how they can interface with design tools programmatically.  
* Comfort working in a fast moving environment where AI augments both the design and engineering sides of the team.

**What can we offer you:**

**🚀 Growth Mindset**

We believe in pushing boundaries and embracing challenges. Whether it’s exploring new tools, improving processes, or taking on uncharted projects, we support a culture of curiosity and innovation where learning never stops.

**🌎 A Diverse, Collaborative Team**

Join a global team that celebrates diversity and thrives on collaboration. With team members from all over the world, we bring together unique perspectives, ideas, and experiences to create meaningful impact and drive innovation.

**📚 Continuous Learning & Development**

No matter your background or field of study, you’ll find endless opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute. Our open, transparent environment encourages the exchange of ideas, helping you unlock your full potential.

**🌟 Career Growth in an Early-Stage Startup**

Be part of a fast-growing startup with global ambitions. As we scale, so will your opportunities to take on more responsibility, shape our success, and advance your career.

**💰 Competitive Compensation Package**

We value your contributions and offer a competitive economic package to match your impact.

**Diversity Statement**

At Prophero, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace where diverse perspectives and backgrounds are not only welcomed but celebrated. We believe that diversity drives innovation and empowers us to build stronger connections with our clients and communities.

Prophero is an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to ensuring a hiring process free from discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our mission is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to achieve their full potential.

### Descripción de la oferta

**At Factorial, we’re growing fast and looking for Product Designers across several vacancies, with at least 3 years of industry experience and a passion for crafting simple solutions to complex problems.**

Join our design team and help us build the most delightful software for running a business\!

**Why Factorial 🚀**

Small and medium businesses face challenges across HR, Finance, Operations, and IT that vertical software rarely solves efficiently; the cost and effort usually outweigh the depth of value. A single product that tackles their biggest pains through a unified experience is far more valuable and worth investing in.

From retail, to startups, to factories, to education, to hospitality, we are building the most advanced software to help people streamline their business operations every day. This puts us in a unique opportunity to tap into the largest corporate market in the world.

**We’re convinced of one thing:** exceptional product design and meticulous craft aren’t just vital, they are the very essence of our strategy.

**What you'll do 📜**

You will partner with a team of Designers, Product Managers, and Engineers to shape, build, and implement strategic solutions that solve user problems and drive business outcomes.

From strategy and research to designing end-to-end flows and prototypes, through to implementation, testing, and validation, you will craft products that solve problems simply and elegantly, paying attention to every detail.

You’ll think holistically across all Factorial surfaces, designing systemic solutions for vertical products while maintaining consistency across the platform.

**Who you are** 👤

You are a good fit if...

* You have **at least 3 years of experience as a Product Designer**, taking part in the **full end-to-end process** of building software.  
* You are passionate about problems, not attached to solutions, and you feel proud only when your work solves them at scale.  
* You feel confident **leading discovery sessions** with customers, surfacing problems down to the smallest detail, detecting patterns, and potential edge cases.  
* You know how to balance user, market, and business inputs (along with your own intuition and gut instinct), to prioritize your decisions.  
* You know how to **collaborate closely with Software Engineers** to understand the technical constraints behind your designs.  
* You are autonomous, resourceful, and see constraints as an opportunity to drive creativity, working iteratively.  
* You can design solutions that balance short-term needs, enabling fast iteration and validation, while also envisioning long-term, ideal outcomes for future iterations.  
* You think in systems and can extrapolate and extend shared patterns and behaviors across the platform.  
* You care deeply about details and push your designs to be pixel-perfect and bug-free during implementation.  
* You can clearly communicate your decisions to a wide range of partners, and you do this through clear and concise writing.  
* You love using software and exploring new technologies to enhance your design process and solutions. Also, you know where to find the right references and inspiration to solve the problem at hand.  
* Feels comfortable **speaking in English** (Spanish is a good to have).

## About the job

👋 At NeuralTrust we're looking for a Principal Product Designer to set the bar for product quality and craft. This is a high-impact, high-expectation role.  
🚀 About NeuralTrust  
We’re a Barcelona-based startup that is rapidly scaling globally to become a leader in AI agent security.Our platform enables organizations to secure agent systems, covering both exposure management and runtime security.  
We operate at the intersection of cybersecurity and AI, building products for technical teams solving complex, high-stakes problems.  
🥷 What You will do  
You will own the quality and coherence of the product experience. You will spend the majority of your time designing, not managing or coordinating. You are expected to bring taste, precision, and systems thinking to a product that deals with inherently complex domains.  
You will:

* Own the end-to-end product experience, with full responsibility for craft, interaction quality, and consistency.  
* Translate complex AI and security workflows into interfaces that feel simple, structured, and inevitable.  
* Define and build a design system that enables speed without sacrificing quality.  
* Impose clarity on ambiguous problems, bringing order, hierarchy, and strong opinions.  
* Work as a product manager, shaping direction and making trade-offs.  
* Maintain a very high bar for visual design, interaction design, and detail.  
* Ship fast, but never sloppy.

⭐️ About You  
This role is for a top-tier individual contributor. We care about output and judgment, not titles.

* You have experience designing complex products (security, developer tools, data platforms, or similar).  
* You have strong visual taste and obsess over details others miss.  
* You can take messy, technical problems and turn them into clean, understandable interfaces.  
* You have a portfolio that shows exceptional craft.  
* Mastery of Figma and experience prototyping with AI tools such as v0.  
* Fluent in English.  
* Based in or willing to relocate to Barcelona (hybrid role).

🚫 This role is not for you if:

* Your strength is coordination rather than product design craft.  
* You need highly defined scopes or extensive direction.  
* You focus more on process than on output quality.  
* You rely heavily on user research to drive decisions instead of strong product judgment.

✨ Benefits

* Competitive salary aligned with your experience and impact.  
* Flexible compensation plan (transport, restaurants, baby daycare…).  
* Hybrid remote flexibility.  
* The latest tools and tech.  
* High growth opportunity.

## About the job

At Heuristik, we are building a best-in-class biometric ID solution powered by a proprietary neural network. As we move into high-stakes clinical environments, we are looking for a Product Owner who wants to sit at the intersection of design, AI innovation, and clinical safety.  
You will be the vital link between our vision and our technical execution. One day you’ll be in Figma, crafting high-fidelity prototypes that visualize AI within clinical workflows; the next, you’ll be in Jira, architecting the SDLC, writing technical requirements, and ensuring our product meets the rigorous standards of ISO 13485 and SaMD compliance.  
We are looking for you if:

* You are fascinated by the potential of technology in healthcare and want to design the future of Clinical AI-human interaction.  
* You find satisfaction in order and documentation — knowing that in healthcare tech, a well-documented Jira ticket is as important as a beautiful UI.  
* You understand that usability is a safety requirement, not just a design preference, and you are comfortable balancing UX with regulatory constraints.  
* You want to be a foundational member of a lean, high-output team where your work directly impacts clinical outcomes and patient safety.

Key Responsibilities  
Product Strategy & SDLC Support (The "PO" Half)

* Requirements Management: Put product at the heart of everything and bridge the gap between company vision, clinical user needs, regulatory requirements and technical feasibility, documenting "the why" behind every feature. Define and document detailed functional requirements, ensuring all features meet clinical safety standards and regulatory compliance (e.g., data privacy, audit trails).  
* Product and SDLC Process Ownership: Prioritize the product backlog based on stakeholder value, clinical urgency, and technical feasibility. Assist the CTO in translating high-level roadmap items into detailed Jira tickets. Work alongside QA to ensure des\&dev outputs match clinical requirements.  
* Act as the vital bridge between Clinical Affairs, our users, vision, and Engineering, ensuring that findings from clinical studies and pilot feedback are accurately translated into actionable product requirements  
* Data Visualisation and the Patient Journey: Design how our biometric ID solution results are visualised and utilised by clinicians, illuminating AI data processing to build trust in our core IP.  
* Regulatory Documentation: Support the maintenance of the Design History File (DHF) and technical files required for ISO 13485, ensuring design changes are documented for audit readiness.  
* Actively contribute to the Risk Management process by identifying use-related hazards and proposing design controls to mitigate risks

Design & Visual Execution (The "Designer" Half)

* Figma Mastery: Own the end-to-end UI/UX. Ensures a consistent design approach aligned with product and brand identity and establishes a robust, scalable Design System that allows for rapid prototyping of Heuristik 3.0  
* High-Stakes Collateral: Employ deep Product knowledge to refine marketing and investor materials. Support sales and marketing efforts with high-quality visuals and materials, including web design of the company landing page.

Experience & Background

* 3+ years in UX/UI, preferably in a Healthcare Web/mobile SaaS environment.   
* 1+ year in a role with Product responsibilities.  
* Knowledge of EU Directive 2019/882 (European Accessibility Act) 28/07/2025  
* Knowledge of, or a willingness to learn, IEC 62366 for Medical Device Usability, specifying a risk-based engineering process to analyze, design, and validate user interfaces.  
* Proficiency in Adobe Suite for vector design, image editing, and animation  
* Technical Interest: genuine interest in AI systems within Clinical environments.   
* Able to take the "big picture" vision and user requirements and translate them into a "ready-for-dev" specs that tech teams trust.  
* Mastery of Jira and Agile project management frameworks.  
* Ability to break down complex clinical workflows into logical, bite-sized development tasks.  
* High-level storytelling for pitch decks, but also granular technical writing for developers.  
* Ability to design Figma prototypes for usability and logic rather than just aesthetics.  
* A "the buck stops here" mentality regarding product quality and release deadlines.  
* Knowledge of healthcare-specific constraints (e.g., ISO 13485, DTAC, or similar) is highly preferred.

## About the job

Freshly Cosmetics, it's an adventure

En Freshly elegimos la cosmética que cuida, que respeta y que contribuye a un mañana mejor. Apostamos por la innovación natural y por crear experiencias que ayuden a las personas a verse y sentirse mejor, siendo fieles a nuestros valores y propósito. Nos movemos por cuatro valores que nos inspiran en todo lo que hacemos: Be Accountable, Be Bold, Be Humble y Be Excellent. Creemos en la responsabilidad, la valentía, la humildad y las ganas de hacerlo siempre mejor. Buscamos personas con propósito, con energía para dejar su huella y con ilusión por crecer junto a una empresa que evoluciona y se transforma cada día.

Si te interesa diseñar experiencias digitales que impacten directamente en resultados de negocio, y quieres trabajar en un entorno donde el diseño tiene peso real en las decisiones, sigue leyendo.

Buscamos a un/a UX & UI Designer con criterio de diseño y foco en conversión, que entienda que una buena interfaz no es solo la que queda bonita, sino la que funciona. Alguien autónomo/a, con ganas de experimentar, medir y mejorar continuamente la experiencia digital de Freshly.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

* Diseñar interfaces web asegurando coherencia visual, usabilidad y orientación a resultados  
* Mantener y evolucionar el Design System en Figma, creando componentes escalables y reutilizables  
* Diseñar y mantener landing pages de adquisición alineadas con la estrategia de paid media, con variantes para testing y adaptación a distintos mercados (ES, IT, PT)  
* Apoyar el roadmap de experimentación CRO, diseñando variantes para tests A/B en coordinación con el equipo de producto  
* Preparar diseños optimizados para su implementación en herramientas de personalización como Dynamic Yield  
* Asegurar que todos los assets digitales (banners, landings, módulos) se visualizan correctamente en todos los dispositivos y resoluciones  
* Preparar el handoff técnico para desarrollo, trabajando sobre Prestashop y landings externas  
* Colaborar con los equipos de producto, ecommerce, desarrollo y branding para asegurar coherencia entre diseño, implementación y objetivos de conversión

¿Qué te hará marcar la diferencia?

* Experiencia en diseño UX/UI con foco en ecommerce, orientado a conversión y resultados  
* Dominio avanzado de Figma: auto layout, componentes, variantes y design systems  
* Experiencia manteniendo o construyendo un Design System  
* Conocimientos de HTML/CSS a nivel intermedio: suficiente para entender la implementación y colaborar con desarrollo  
* Uso fluido de herramientas de IA aplicadas al flujo de diseño (Claude, ChatGPT, generación de imagen/UI) para acelerar producción y exploración

Se valorará especialmente:

* Experiencia previa en ecommerce DTC de consumo (cosmética, suplementación, salud, wellness o similar)  
* Familiaridad con datos de comportamiento (GA4, A/B testing, heatmaps, session recordings) para informar decisiones de diseño  
* Experiencia con herramientas de personalización y testing (Dynamic Yield, VWO, Optimizely o similares)

¿Qué te ofrece Freshly a cambio?

* Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.  
* Es una vacante en Freshly Park, nuestras oficinas en Reus, donde podrás disfrutar de un ambiente cercano y retador. y unas oficinas equipadas para trabajar de la mejor manera.  
* Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo: ofrecemos un equilibrio entre trabajo en oficina y teletrabajo, con tres días presenciales y dos días de teletrabajo opcional a la semana..  
* Nuestra manera de trabajar apuesta por la autonomía, la responsabilidad y la flexibilidad horaria.  
* Ponemos a tu disposición todas las facilidades, recursos y herramientas que necesites para el desarrollo de tu trabajo.  
* Mutua médica privada gratuita para el equipo y con descuentos para familiares.

Si quieres conocernos mejor:

* Visita nuestra web: https://www.freshlycosmetics.com/es/unete-freshly-team  
* Síguenos en LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/freshlycosmetics

Si crees que este es tu rol y que las responsabilidades descritas son lo que estás buscando, ¡inscríbete en la vacante, tenemos ganas de conocerte\!. Y si no eres tú, pero conoces a alguien quién pueda encajarle y sumarse a esta nueva aventura, ¡no dudes en compartirla\! ¡Tenemos ganas de conocerte\!

The Freshly Team, with love

## About the job

Te apasiona diseñar soluciones que mueven a miles de personas? En Shakers buscamos un/a Senior Product Designer para liderar la experiencia de una App móvil (conductor/pasajero) líder en el sector marketplace B2C. Buscamos a alguien con mentalidad de producto, capaz de asumir el *ownership* total desde la definición del problema hasta su impacto en las métricas de negocio.  
🚀 El Reto: Diseño Nativo con Impacto  
Al ser un producto exclusivamente móvil, tu enfoque debe estar en la interacción, usabilidad y patrones de diseño nativos (iOS/Android). No buscamos solo estética; buscamos a alguien que conecte objetivos de negocio con la experiencia del usuario para influir activamente en el *roadmap* junto a PMs y Desarrollo.  
🛠️ ¿Qué harás? (Responsabilidades Clave)

* Ownership Mobile End-to-End: Liderar el diseño de flujos complejos en una aplicación marketplace B2C.  
* Decisión Estratégica: Conectar métricas y UX para priorizar oportunidades y defender decisiones ante *stakeholders*.  
* IA & Discovery: Integrar herramientas de IA para acelerar la síntesis de *insights* y la exploración de soluciones.  
* Prototipado de Alta Fidelidad: Crear prototipos pensados para producción, reduciendo la distancia con la implementación.  
* Continuous Discovery: Validar soluciones con usuarios reales mediante ciclos constantes de *research* y *testing*.  
* Design System Mobile: Mantener y escalar un sistema de diseño pragmático que garantice velocidad en un entorno de *releases* frecuentes.  
* Craft & Excelencia: Marcar el estándar en UI, interacción y accesibilidad nativa para elevar el nivel de *craft*.

📋 Condiciones del Proyecto

* Modelo de contratación: Freelance a través de Shakers.  
* Dedicación: Full-time.  
* Ubicación: Híbrido en Madrid (Tetuán).  
* Duración: Proyecto de largo plazo (hasta finales de 2026 con posibilidad de extensión).

✅ ¿Qué buscamos?

* Experiencia Mobile: Trayectoria sólida como Product Designer enfocada en Apps móviles, con portfolio de productos reales en producción.  
* Mentalidad de Negocio: Priorización por impacto, riesgo y retorno.  
* Dominio de Figma: Nivel avanzado en componentes, variables, librerías y prototipado móvil.  
* IA & Vibe Coding: Familiaridad con herramientas de IA para acelerar la iteración entre diseño y tecnología.  
* Research Integrado: Experiencia estableciendo prácticas de validación de forma recurrente en el día a día.  
* Autonomía: Capacidad para tomar decisiones con información imperfecta en equipos cross-funcionales.

¿Eres un perfil hands-on con capacidad para influir en el futuro de la movilidad? Inscríbete y diseña la experiencia que transforma la manera en que nos desplazamos.

## About the job

Somos Glintt Global, una empresa portuguesa/española, líder en tecnología, con más de 30 años de experiencia. Queremos impactar en la calidad de vida de las personas a través de la innovación, la tecnología, el conocimiento y la ambición. ¡Este es nuestro compromiso\!

Para eso, ¡te necesitamos\! Estamos buscando un/a UX/UI Designer para unirse al equipo de Glintt Next\! En nuestra empresa, tendrás la oportunidad de combinar todos tus intereses y habilidades para ayudarnos a hacer el mundo un poco más Glintter\!

¿Cómo será tu día a día en Glintt Next?

En Glintt Next para nuestro parner lider en Telco te encargarás de diseñar experiencias digitales centradas en el usuario, trabajando de forma cercana con Product Managers, equipos de desarrollo, stakeholders y otros perfiles de negocio.

Participarás en todo el ciclo de diseño, desde la definición de problemas y necesidades de usuario hasta la conceptualización, prototipado y validación de soluciones. Colaborarás activamente en la toma de decisiones de producto, asegurando que las soluciones sean usables, coherentes y alineadas con los objetivos de negocio.

Además, contribuirás a la evolución del Design System, garantizando consistencia y escalabilidad en los productos digitales, y fomentarás una cultura de diseño basada en la colaboración, el aprendizaje continuo y la mejora constante en un entorno dinámico y en constante evolución.

¿Cómo te imaginamos?

* Definir flujos de usuario, arquitecturas de información y modelos de interacción.  
* Crear wireframes y prototipos (low & high fidelity) para validar soluciones.  
* Iterar de forma continua basándote en feedback de usuarios, datos y stakeholders.  
* Asegurar la coherencia de la experiencia en todos los puntos de contacto digitales.  
* Diseñar, mantener y evolucionar el Design System.  
* Crear y gestionar librerías de componentes en Figma (components, variants, auto-layout).  
* Definir foundations: colores, tipografía, spacing, iconografía y motion.  
* Implementar design tokens en colaboración con desarrollo.  
* Promover la adopción del sistema dentro de la organización.  
* Trabajar en entornos ágiles junto a PMs, developers, QA y data.  
* Participar y facilitar workshops, design sprints y sesiones de ideación.  
* Preparar handoffs claros y bien documentados para desarrollo.  
* Defender decisiones de diseño basadas en datos y principios de usabilidad.  
* Contribuir a la cultura de diseño (critiques, revisiones, buenas prácticas).

Lo que buscamos

* 4 a 6 años de experiencia en UX/UI Design en entornos de producto digital.  
* Portfolio sólido que demuestre proceso de diseño: investigación, iteración y entrega final.  
* Experiencia en research con usuarios (entrevistas, tests de usabilidad, análisis de datos cualitativos).  
* Dominio de Figma: componentes, variants, auto-layout, prototipado y handoff.  
* Experiencia trabajando con o contribuyendo a Design Systems.  
* Capacidad para trabajar en entornos ágiles (Scrum/Kanban).  
* Conocimientos de accesibilidad digital.  
* Conocimientos básicos de HTML y CSS para una colaboración efectiva con desarrollo.  
* Habilidad para comunicar y presentar decisiones de diseño a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.

¿Qué encontrarás en Glintt Global?

## About the job

Trinetix is looking for a talented UI/UX Designer with strong experience in creating intuitive, user-centered digital products, including interfaces for AI-powered features such as chatbots and agentic systems. This role involves close collaboration with product managers, business analysts, and engineering teams to design seamless, accessible, and scalable user experiences. The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable translating complex functionality into clear and engaging designs.

Requirements

* 4+ years of experience in a UI/UX Designer role  
* Strong expertise in designing intuitive and user-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications  
* Experience designing AI-powered features, including chatbots or intelligent/agentic systems  
* Proficiency in user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design solutions  
* Solid understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design principles  
* Ability to collaborate closely with product, business, and engineering teams  
* Proficiency with design and collaboration tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Abstract, and Miro  
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS to support effective collaboration with developers  
* Strong communication and presentation skills

Languages

* English: at least Upper-Intermediate (B2, all of our clients speak English, and our designers often participate in conversations)

Nice-to-Haves

* Experience designing data-heavy or enterprise-level applications  
* Familiarity with Gen AI behaviors and human-AI interaction patterns  
* Experience working in Agile / SCRUM environments  
* Background in design systems or component-based design  
* Experience working with cross-functional and distributed teams

Core Responsibilities

* Design intuitive, user-centered interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products  
* Create UX flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI designs for new features and enhancements  
* Design and refine interfaces for AI-powered features, including chatbots and agentic systems  
* Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions  
* Ensure accessibility and usability best practices are applied across all designs  
* Collaborate closely with product managers, business analysts, and engineers to ensure design feasibility and alignment  
* Maintain and evolve design systems, guidelines, and documentation  
* Support Agile delivery by participating in sprint planning, reviews, and design discussions

What we offer

* Continuous learning and career growth opportunities  
* Professional training and English/Spanish language classes  
* Comprehensive medical insurance  
* Mental health support  
* Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more  
* Flexible working hours  
* Inclusive and supportive culture

About Us

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture.

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics.

To learn more about how we collect, process, and store your personal data, please review our Privacy Notice: https://www.trinetix.com/corporate-policies/privacy-notice

## About the job

*This position is based in Spain. Candidates must have legal authorization to work in Spain and possess at least a conversational level of Spanish to collaborate effectively with the team.*  
\# Job Description  
We’re looking for a Product Designer (UX/UI) with 4+ years of experience who’s excited to transform Influencity’s challenges into intuitive, scalable, and meaningful digital solutions.  
If you see design as the perfect intersection of user experience, information architecture, and business goals—and you enjoy working on complex SaaS products—you’re the person we’re looking for.  
You’ll join a multidisciplinary team working in agile environments, focused on continuous product improvement and delivering real value to our users.  
\# Key Responsibilities

* Design and evolve end-to-end UX/UI experiences for a B2B SaaS product  
* Turn business insights, data, and research into clear, actionable design solutions  
* Create beautiful and highly functional interfaces, ensuring consistency through Design Systems  
* Collaborate closely with PMs, engineers, and designers to ship impactful features  
* Participate in Agile rituals (sprints, refinements, reviews)  
* Validate hypotheses through research, testing, and results analysis  
* Keep clear documentation of your process and design decisions

\# Experience & Technical Skills

* 4+ years as Product Designer / UX/UI Designer in digital products  
* Proven experience in SaaS products (ideally B2B)  
* Strong end-to-end design process: research → ideation → prototyping → validation → handoff  
* Research mindset: choose the right methodology and extract actionable learnings  
* Strong visual/UI craft \+ attention to detail \+ Design Systems experience  
* Organized and comfortable managing complexity while delivering on sprint timelines  
* Experience in Agile / continuous delivery environments  
* Clear, persuasive communication across technical, business, and executive audiences  
* Proactive, positive, collaborative, and comfortable giving/receiving feedback

\# Soft Skills & Mindset

* Experience in data/analytics products or complex platforms  
* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge  
* Experience scaling or evolving a large Design System  
* Familiarity with product metrics, UX KPIs, user behavior analysis  
* Continuous testing experience

\# Why Influencity?  
At Influencity, you’ll be part of a fast-growing company where learning and professional development are part of our culture.

* Work in a rapidly expanding company with exciting challenges.  
* Flexible hours.  
* Remote-friendly role based in Spain.

\*If you are in Madrid, we operate on a flexible hybrid model (going to the office occasionally).  
\*If you are based outside of Madrid, you will be asked to travel to our HQ approximately once every 2 months for team alignment.

* Extra time off: December 24th & 31st, plus your birthday\!  
* Choose your laptop: MacBook or Windows (Lenovo, HP, Dell).  
* High-trust work culture with autonomy and ownership in your role.  
* Career development opportunities: Performance reviews twice a year.  
* Young, dynamic team with a "let’s make it happen" mentality.  
* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.  
* Employee benefits package (transport, training, meals, gym membership discounts, childcare and more).  
* Medical & dental insurance.  
* Language classes in working hours.

\# About Us  
Founded in 2014, Influencity (Influencity.com) is the most complete AI-powered influencer marketing platform in the market. With over 70M influencers in our database, we provide brands and agencies with a full stack of solutions to manage campaigns at scale.  
Our mission is to become the global leader in influencer marketing. To achieve this, we need an exceptional team that thrives on growth, collaboration, and innovation. At Influencity, we believe in supporting each other, overcoming challenges together, and continuously improving—both individually and as a team.  
If this sounds like you, THIS IS YOUR TEAM\! We’re excited to meet you\! 🚀  
\# How to Apply?

* Send us your Resume/CV to jobs@influencity.com  
* Respond to these 3 questions in your email:  
* Why do you want to work at Influencity?  
* What is the value you can offer to Influencity?  
* Why do you think that we should hire you?

*Note: applications that don’t follow the application process will be automatically rejected.*

### Benefits found in job post

* Dental insurance

# Senior UX Designer (remote, UTC-3 to UTC+3)

## Location

Remote (UTC-3 to UTC+3); Berlin; Madrid; Sofia

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Product

## Compensation

* Similar cost of market as UK, Germany, etc.€78K – €91K • Offers Equity  
* Similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine, etc.€70K – €82K • Offers Equity

[Tier Guide](https://www.notion.so/checkly/Our-Pay-Calculator-How-we-pay-our-team-f3c42feab82b444a9cbf8fed545cb727)

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a [standardized salary calculator](https://www.notion.so/f3c42feab82b444a9cbf8fed545cb727) that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

[Overview](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkly/93822939-0e54-48f1-8747-1a754d72351c?utm_source=3PLlpnaozL)[Application](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkly/93822939-0e54-48f1-8747-1a754d72351c/application?utm_source=3PLlpnaozL)

*(Fully remote, async-first, DevTool SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)*

Location: This is a FULLY remote role, but you must be within UTC-3 to UTC+3 to work with your team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 timezone.

\--

Join [Checkly](https://www.checklyhq.com/) as a Senior UX Designer and empower developers to own and ensure application performance and reliability \- from pull request to post-mortem\!

Checkly helps engineers build reliable products by unifying testing, monitoring and observability. OpenTelemetry, Playwright, and Monitoring as Code are our foundation for unifying performance and reliability.

Our tech stack is Vue.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in\!

Thousands of developers—teams at 1Password, CrowdStrike, Render, LinkedIn and Vercel included—trust Checkly to keep their apps running smoothly. In 2024, we raised [$20M in Series B](https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/) funding from Balderton, CRV, and Accel to take things to the next level.

We care about building a team where people of all backgrounds are encouraged to do their best work. To achieve this we built a [flexible, remote-first and async-first](https://blog.checklyhq.com/how-to-build-a-leading-remote-first-company-while-exceeding-company-goals-do-this/) startup environment with [inclusive benefits](https://www.notion.so/Benefits-Perks-ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=21) and full transparency about how we pay.

## What you'll do

As a Designer, you will lead design of the Checkly product. You’ll drive the vision, and help shape the future of our platform experience end to end. You will report to our SVP of Product & Engineering, [Daniel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-paulus-checkly/), and work closely with our Product Managers and Engineers.

* Lead the product design of Checkly's platform. You'll be the go-to person for the team when they need design decisions about user experience and the interface.  
* Bridge design and development by prototyping in code when needed and collaborating closely with frontend engineers on implementation.  
* Shape the design vision for new features, contributing from early exploration through implementation and iteration.  
* Be in close contact with support and customer success teams and our users to really understand customers' problems.  
* Co-develop and maintain our growing design system with Engineering, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and performance.  
* Champion high standards of UI/UX and developer experience across teams while being pragmatic about tradeoffs.  
* Use AI tools daily as a core part of your workflow, from generating and iterating on designs to prototyping and writing code, and actively push the boundaries of what AI-assisted design can look like.

## What we use

* Claude for almost everything.  
* Slack for day to day comms.  
* Figma for almost everything.  
* Miro for white boarding.  
* Vue for frontend dev.  
* Tailwind as base for component library.  
* Vercel for deployment & previews.  
* Notion for all document related stuff.  
* Multiple AI tools such as Pencil, Figma AI, Raycast, etc.

## What you should have

* Experience designing data-heavy screens: graphs, tables, charts, etc.  
* Experience working on design-systems.  
* Past experience as a frontend engineer or ability to (vibe) code if needed.  
* Deep comfort working with AI tools every day, using them to move faster, write and iterate on code, and stay ahead of the curve  
* Ability to visualize and prototype your ideas quickly and confidently work with AI to move faster.  
* Not in love with your own work and know when to move on.  
* Great at juggling multiple projects at once.  
* Excellent spoken and written English skills.  
* Ability to be autonomous and self-motivated in a remote work environment, while you also enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping others.  
* FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones.

## Why us?

* Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)  
* [Remote-first](https://blog.checklyhq.com/we-scored-10-5-on-gitlabs-12-steps-to-better-remote-test/), [flexible work hours](https://www.notion.so/75c4fb08dc49400cabee6a3a9b827cc5?pvs=21), [async-first](https://www.notion.so/b9dd37bec51d436bae6635ffce8c6730?pvs=21) (low meeting, high productivity) and [transparent culture](https://www.notion.so/b130664febf94ae9b320bd4a78370f2e?pvs=21)  
* Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters—your impact won’t get lost in layers of bureaucracy.  
* Stock options  
* 27 days of paid vacation \+ your local public holidays  
* Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave  
* $1,500 learning, visiting and wellness budget  
* Co-working budget or home office setup  
* Annual company off-site

Find out more [here](https://www.notion.so/Benefits-Perks-ad474bec3a5d4d17bfbb43ebae3fec9c?pvs=21).

## What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a [standardized salary calculator](https://pay.checklyhq.com/) that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

* €78k-€91k for a Senior Designer in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, \+ stock options.  
* €70k-€82k for Senior Designer in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, \+ stock options.

## Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply\! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you\!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our [hiring playbook](https://www.notion.so/Checkly-Hiring-Playbook-54bc05178d3b4118a15effe885f96d1a?pvs=21) and open-sourced our [employee handbook](https://www.notion.so/Checkly-s-Employee-Handbook-f262e36a64d641af8588a1c09bc0ff48?pvs=21). There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

## About the job

¡En Tribal estamos buscando una persona como tú\! ¿Te apetece?

Tribal Worldwide \- ¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una consultora de diseño orientada al crecimiento. Nos dedicamos a resolver los retos que nos plantean nuestros clientes, manteniendo siempre un contacto cercano, honesto y directo con ellos. Buscamos tener el mayor impacto posible a la hora de mejorar sus negocios.

Trabajamos con ganas, aportando calidad, honestidad y transparencia en todos y cada uno de nuestros proyectos. Si buscas un lugar para crecer profesionalmente, aprender de gente muy talentosa y disfrutar de un ambiente cercano, ¡Queremos conocerte\!”

¿Por qué te estamos buscando?

Buscamos a alguien que se una a nuestra tribu para trabajar en un gran retailer líder en el sector, con un rol claro: ayudarnos a definir qué debemos construir y por qué, antes de pensar en cómo se ve.

Queremos reforzar nuestra capacidad de entender profundamente a usuarios, traducir ese conocimiento en decisiones estratégicas de experiencia y asegurar que todo lo que diseñamos responde a una lógica clara y coherente.

Este rol no va solo de diseñar interfaces. Va de:

* Definir problemas con precisión  
* Detectar oportunidades reales a partir de investigación y datos  
* Construir marcos de experiencia (journeys, opportunity maps, principios) que guíen al equipo  
* Alinear a producto, negocio y tecnología en torno a una visión común

Buscamos a alguien que disfrute especialmente la parte de entender antes de diseñar. Alguien que salga a campo, hable con usuarios, observe, cuestione y profundice hasta tener claridad. Que sea capaz de convertir insights en dirección accionable.

También queremos a alguien que no espere instrucciones. Este rol requiere iniciativa: anticiparse, proponer, estructurar y empujar decisiones en entornos donde no siempre todo está definido.

Valoramos mucho el “olfato”: capacidad de detectar patrones, conectar señales dispersas y convertir el ruido en claridad.

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

Experiencia laboral:

Al menos 4 años trabajando en producto digital, con foco en UX, research y definición de experiencias.

Valoramos especialmente experiencia en entornos complejos o con múltiples stakeholders.

Experiencia en investigación ágil:

* Diseñar y ejecutar investigación cualitativa y cuantitativa (entrevistas, shadowing, tests, análisis de datos, benchmark…)  
* Sintetizar información compleja en insights claros y accionables  
* Traducir esos insights en decisiones de producto y dirección de experiencia

Estrategia y dirección:

* Definir problem statements, áreas de oportunidad y principios de experiencia  
* Construir customer journeys end-to-end, mapas de oportunidad y frameworks que guíen el diseño  
* Aportar una visión estructurada que conecte necesidades de usuario, objetivos de negocio y viabilidad técnica

Pensar en flujos:

* Capacidad para bajar a UX (flows, wireframes, prototipos) cuando sea necesario  
* Dar dirección y feedback con foco en claridad, coherencia y escalabilidad  
* Entender las limitaciones y oportunidades técnicas para tomar decisiones realistas

Conocimientos de diseño de producto:

* Figma y sistemas de diseño  
* Familiaridad con herramientas de research, documentación y prototipado

Idiomas

* Inglés suficiente para defender tu trabajo en reuniones y conversaciones profesionales

Además, valoramos mucho si…

*Who are we?*

We are part of the Alkemy Group, specializing in driving growth through our technological expertise, tackling complex challenges, and fostering operational excellence.

We invite you to get to know us in depth by exploring the various sections of our website.

About The Role

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer to create exceptional and visually appealing digital experiences.

You’ll work closely with development, marketing, and product teams to design intuitive interfaces that optimize user experience and achieve business goals.

*What do we value?*

* 2–3 years of UX/UI experience in digital products or apps.  
* Strong portfolio (wireframes, prototypes, UI designs).  
* Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, InVision or similar.  
* Knowledge of UX principles, usability, accessibility, and user-centered design.  
* Experience in user testing and design iteration.

What Will You Do

* Design visually consistent and user-friendly interfaces.  
* Collaborate with development, product, and marketing teams.  
* Test and iterate designs based on user feedback and data.  
* Maintain design systems and style guides for consistency.

Valued tools and skills:

* Design Tools: Figma, Adobe XD, InVision.  
* UX/UI: Wireframes, prototyping, interaction design, usability.  
* Web basics: HTML, CSS.

*What do we offer you?*

At Alkemy, we work to help people develop their talent in a collaborative, demanding, and stimulating environment where ideas become reality.

Active participation in the evolution of our services toward more intelligent, automated, and differentiated models, with AI applied to business.

Would you like to grow with us?

If you’re looking for an environment where analytics plays a strategic role, innovation is applied with sound judgment, and data generates real impact…

We look forward to meeting you at Alkemy.

## About the job

🏢 About Twind

Twind is the next-generation SaaS B2B platform for Contractor Activity Coordination (CAE). Built by CTAIMA, with over 20 years of experience in Occupational Risk Prevention, Twind operates in 25+ countries with clients including Adidas, Renault, Nestlé, Bayer, Mercedes-Benz and Mango.

Our mission is simple: we want people to work safely and with peace of mind. To get there, we build a product that automates document management, access control and compliance between companies and their contractors.

We are certified in ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 45001, a Microsoft Gold Partner, and recognized as a Happy Company, because we take care of our users and our team equally.

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to take real ownership of Twind's Design System and become a quality design reference within our product squad.

We're not looking for someone to execute tickets. We're looking for someone who leads with conviction, connects design with business and engineering, and raises the bar for the product in a sustainable way.

At Twind, we believe design isn't just aesthetics, it's the difference between a tool people love and one they merely tolerate. We're looking for someone who feels the same way.

🔧Responsibilities

Design System

* Be the primary owner of Twind's Design System, its maintenance, evolution and documentation (Figma \+ Storybook \+ tokens).  
* Ensure visual and functional consistency across all platforms and languages (the product runs in 10+ languages).  
* Work closely with Engineering to guarantee correct component implementation.  
* Define and maintain design tokens as the single source of truth for the system.

Product Design (UX/UI)

* Design flows, wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for new product features.  
* Work within a product squad in agile cycles, contributing from discovery through to delivery.  
* Iterate on designs based on data and real user feedback.

User Research

* Plan and run research sessions (interviews, usability tests, heuristic evaluations).  
* Translate insights into actionable design decisions for the team.

Engineering Collaboration

* Bridge the gap between design and development: clear handoffs, precise specs and support during implementation.  
* Actively participate in squad refinements and planning sessions.

🧠 What We're Looking For

Must-have

* 5–8 years of experience in Product Design, with at least 2 years of ownership over a Design System in production.  
* Advanced proficiency in Figma (auto layout, variables, components, advanced prototyping).  
* Hands-on experience with Storybook and design tokens.  
* Ability to document and communicate design decisions clearly.  
* Product mindset: you understand the business, the user and the technology.  
* Full professional proficiency in English, this is the team's working language.

Nice to have

* Experience in B2B SaaS products with multiple user profiles.  
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1).  
* Experience with documentation tools such as Notion or Zeroheight.  
* Familiarity with agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).

💜 Why Twind

* Real impact: your work helps thousands of people work in safer environments across Europe and Latin America.  
* Genuine ownership: the Design System is yours. You propose, decide and execute.  
* A mature product with real challenges: you're not starting from scratch, but there's plenty to build and improve.  
* A team with values: we demonstrate ownership, prioritize growth, put the customer first, and are enthusiastic problem-solvers.  
* 100% remote: work from wherever you are, with the autonomy you deserve.  
* A company with purpose: 20+ years building technology that protects people.

📩 Interested?

Send your portfolio \+ CV directly via LinkedIn.

We care about your process as much as the final result.

*Twind is committed to diversity and inclusion. All applications are welcome regardless of gender, background, age or ability.*

## About the job

About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco \- we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Product Designer, you will be responsible for crafting intuitive, delightful user experiences that seamlessly span mobile (iOS and Android) and web platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Product Management, Engineering, and User Research—to translate complex requirements into elegant, user-centered designs. You will leverage your design sensibilities, storytelling abilities, and understanding of technology constraints to build consistent, scalable solutions that resonate with a wide range of users.

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.

Responsibilities

* Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to deeply understand user needs, pain points, and behaviors. Translate insights into wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.  
* Develop and maintain design systems and component libraries that ensure a cohesive look and feel across iOS, Android, and web interfaces while respecting platform-specific patterns and guidelines.  
* Own the entire design process \- from concept ideation and user flows to final visual design \- ensuring a pixel-perfect, responsive experience across devices and screen sizes.  
* Work closely with Product Managers to shape product strategy and define requirements, and partner with Engineers to ensure technical feasibility and a smooth handoff of assets and specifications.  
* Continuously refine designs based on user feedback, A/B testing results, and analytics. Strive for iterative improvements that drive measurable increases in user satisfaction, engagement, and retention.  
* Advocate for user experience best practices and contribute to the ongoing improvement of design processes, tooling, and team culture.  
* Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced designers, fostering a collaborative and inclusive design environment.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related field.  
* Approximately 3+ years of experience in modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD).  
* Solid understanding of layout, typography, and color theory, with an eye for detail and usability.  
* Familiarity with native mobile design patterns (Human Interface Guidelines for iOS, Material Design for Android) as well as responsive web design principles.  
* Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and applying both qualitative and quantitative feedback to improve designs.

What benefits are we offering?

* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.  
* Annual Bonus  
* Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.  
* Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.  
* Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.  
* Childcare support.  
* Air Conference \- an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.  
* Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.  
* Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.  
* Meals 100% free at the hub.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.

Application Disclaimer

At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

Compensation Range: €36K \- €46K
