## About the job

*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

User Experience

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place\! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Overview of the Role

The Product Growth and GTM team is seeking a Senior Product Designer to shape intuitive, impactful experiences for our seller tools used by sales teams worldwide. In this role, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and our Sales organisation to understand user needs, drive design strategy, and deliver solutions grounded in evidence and aligned to our product vision.

You'll work across the full design lifecycle — from discovery and research through prototyping, testing, and delivery — and play a key role in advancing the quality, consistency, and impact of our design output.

Our design team plays a strategic role in shaping seller tools that are intuitive, evidence-led, and built for measurable impact — helping sellers succeed every day. You'll have the opportunity to improve tooling at scale, influence product strategy, and elevate how design drives business outcomes.

Responsibilities

* Lead and drive research-informed design across multiple high-impact seller tools and experiences.  
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define UX vision, success criteria, and execution plans.  
* Translate user insights into intuitive flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished UI deliverables.  
* Facilitate cross-functional alignment through workshops, design critiques, and structured collaboration.  
* Advocate for inclusive, accessible design solutions that scale across diverse user personas.  
* Contribute to and evolve design systems, pattern libraries, and reusable UX assets.  
* Support process excellence by helping refine intake, scoping, handoff, and QA practices.  
* Measure and iterate on product experiences based on behavioural metrics and user feedback.

Required Qualifications

* 3–5 years of professional experience in product design, ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.  
* Demonstrated ability to lead design through workshop, research, execution, testing, and handoff in cross-functional teams.  
* Strong portfolio that showcases user-centered product design process and visual craft.  
* Experience with user research methods, synthesizing insights, and translating them into product outcomes.  
* Advocates for design decisions and challenges assumptions when necessary.  
* Demonstrates effective cross-departmental collaboration, maintains communication efficiency, and develops actionable plans for design execution.  
* Strong collaboration skills with PMs, Engineers, Researchers, and other stakeholders.  
* Proficiency with user-centered design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma), along with the ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to enhance product innovation and streamline workflows.  
* Knowledge of accessibility best practices and experience creating inclusive products.  
* Demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.  
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

* Strong systems thinking and experience contributing to design systems.  
* Background working on tools for sales, go-to-market teams, or enterprise workflows.  
* Proficiency in UI architecture, including site mapping.

Benefits & Perks

Check out our [benefits site](https://salesforcebenefits.com/index.html) which explains our various benefits, including wellbeing reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more.

Salesforce Information

Check out our [Salesforce Engineering Site](https://engineering.salesforce.com/).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best*, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best*. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this [Accommodations Request Form](https://careers.mail.salesforce.com/accommodations-request-form?_ga=2.139086459.912759425.1690463420-976932181.1684251251).

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our [Candidate Privacy Statement](https://www.salesforce.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/documents/legal/Privacy/salesforce-candidate-privacy-statement-december-2024.pdf) for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. [Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.](https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal) Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

## About the job

*🚀* Psss, sí sí, tú… ¿Quieres ser nuestro/a próximo/a astronauta? *🚀*

En Product Hackers diseñamos y desarrollamos productos digitales. Forma parte de nuestro ADN el analizar cuáles son las problemáticas que afectan a un negocio para acabar pensando cómo la tecnología puede resolverlas.

Si el cuerpo te pide marcha, no te asusta involucrarte en proyectos muy dispares (tanto para clientes como para nuestros propios productos) y te llama más un reto que a un tonto un lápiz... Sigue leyendo que esto te puede interesar.

¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?

Tu objetivo será comprender los comportamientos, las necesidades y las motivaciones de los usuarios a través de técnicas de observación, análisis de tareas y otras metodologías de retroalimentación.

Además, deberás implantar y ejecutar diseños para productos digitales que nos permitan experimentar y llegar a los objetivos de nuestro clientes.

¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?

Buscamos un/a diseñador/a muy top en UX research, visualmente potente, con conocimientos en creación de sistemas de diseño, narrativa y prototipado HI-FI. Es fundamental que tengas soltura y rapidez creando prototipos Lo-Hi para validar con product managers y/o clientes así como también diseños finales que entregarás y explicarás al equipo de desarrollo para su construcción.

Por último, esperamos que tenga muy buenas capacidades sociales ya que deberá participar en distintas dinámicas y reuniones, presentar y defender frecuentemente sus briefs, prototipos o diseños a stakeholders internos y/o externos.

Queremos a alguien que sepa lo que hace y quiera demostrarlo, encaje con nuestra cultura de empresa y quiera formar parte de ella, le guste trabajar rodeado de buenas personas y no tenga miedo a los retos.

¿Qué me dices? ¿Eres tú?

¿QUÉ TE HARÁ TRIUNFAR CON NOSOTROS?

* Al menos 4 años de experiencia como diseñador de productos digitales.  
* Conocimientos en User Research: user test, entrevistas, heatmaps, screen recordings, evaluaciones heurísticas etc…  
* Experiencia diseñando productos para web y app.  
* Soltura en todas las etapas de diseño e investigación: user research, definición de producto, prototyping, visual design, etc.  
* Fundamental conocimientos y soltura en la creación de Design System.  
* Soltura y rapidez creando prototipos Lo-FI & Hi-Fi.  
* Experto en Figma.  
* Visual potente, pasión por el detalle y cuidado por la estética.  
* Carácter autodidacta.  
* Experto hablando, argumentando y presentando a cliente  
* Conocimiento profundo de las metodologías de diseño de producto.  
* Experiencia trabajando con equipos de desarrollo ágiles.  
* Capacidad de priorización y gestión de tareas de diseño.  
* Capacidad de autogestión.  
* Responsabilidad.  
* Obsesión por la perfección.  
* Soltura hablando en público y argumentando diseños.  
* Compromiso en el trabajo.  
* Nivel de inglés B1.

ADEMÁS, SERÁ IDEAL SI TÚ...

* Experiencia con Framer.  
* Conocimientos en HTML & CSS.  
* Experiencia internacional.  
* Conocimientos en Google Analytics.  
* Gusto por las tipografías  
* Haber trabajado A/B testing de forma directa o indirecta con otros equipos.

TE OFRECEMOS

* Full remoto \+ flexibilidad horaria amplia (con la limitación de los horarios de los clientes y reuniones de equipo) ⏰  
* Salario entre 30.000-35.000 euros/brutos anuales (en función de expertise) 💰  
* Retribución flexible 💸  
* Festivos de tu CCAA y locales ✌🏼  
* 25 días de descanso (22 días laborables de vacaciones \+ el día de tu cumpleaños, el 24 y el 31 de diciembre) 🎄  
* Jornada reducida en los meses de verano (julio y agosto) 🏖️  
* Acceso a nuestra plataforma de formación PH School\! Valorado en en \+3000€/año 👨🏻‍💻  
* 500€ de presupuesto para adecuar tu puesto de trabajo en casa \+ ordenador de empresa (un Macbook Pro). 💻  
* Clases en pareja para mejorar tu inglés todas las semanas y conocer a tus compis 🇬🇧  
* Eventos de Product Hackers y teambuilding 🫂  
* Incentivo por traer nuevos compañeros a Product Hackers 🤑  
* Bonus de un porcentaje de lo facturado si nos traes a un cliente 💸  
* Plan de desarrollo y formación para que sigas creciendo como profesional de Product Hackers 🚀  
* Además de muchos otros más que están por venir porque nos gusta ampliar la lista siempre que podemos ❤️

¿CUÁLES SON LAS FASES DEL PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN?

* 1era fase: Entrevista de background & Valores con HR 👩🏼‍💼  
* 2da fase: Prueba técnica (ejercicio práctico) 📝  
* 3era fase: Entrevista técnica con el Hiring Manager 👨🏼‍💼  
* 4ta fase: Oferta e incorporación. ¡Comienza la aventura\! 👩🏼‍🚀

## About the job

What do we do?

Introducing Thinkproject Platform

Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.

By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.

What your day will look like

Mission

You will contribute to the future of how the construction industry will collaborate digitally with stunning user experience and interface designs by being actively involved in defining product development, innovation, and creation.

Main Responsibilities

* You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, and customers to gain a profound understanding of product requirements  
* You will design usable experiences and interfaces for our products, and translate them into testable low, mid, and high-fidelity prototypes.  
* You will be a part of a design team working together with the common process and supporting each other on daily basis.  
* You will actively shape and create a design culture at Thinkproject.  
* You will present product designs to stakeholders.  
* You will verify product experiences with end-users through user research methods.  
* You will contribute to Thinkproject wide design system.

What you need to fulfill the role

Technical Experience

* You have at least 3 years of experience in Product (UX/UI) Design Role.  
* You have proven record of designing and shipping multiple digital product designs including desktop and mobile apps (native and cross-platform).  
* You have a portfolio that demonstrates a keen sense of visual design, the ability to solve user problems and create design deliverables for responsive mobile and web applications.  
* You are familiar with Research and UX wireframing tools and you can explain and present UX flows.  
* You have an experience in SaaS web applications and B2B software.  
* You know how to manage complex Design Systems, and you are familiar with Google Material Design.  
* You can work and contribute to existing design libraries.  
* You have experience working with accessible interfaces (according to AA standards)  
* You have a good eye for UI and the details.  
* You can maintain a high degree of independence, you are a hands-on person, and you care about personal responsibility, at the same time you support your colleagues.  
* You are quick and confident with being a part of fast-paced environment.  
* You know how to provide a good UI solutions in short amount of time, you can do good research, and you know where to look for it.  
* You understand the deadline timeline delivery and you can organize your work accordingly.  
* You are ok working with Scrum and Design Sprints·  
* You want to grow within the company and expand your responsibilities.  
* You are familiar with high fidelity prototyping.  
* You are fluent with Figma (our tool of choice).  
* Fluent in English

What we offer

Lunch 'n' Learn Sessions I Women's Network I LGBTQIA+ Network I Coffee Chat Roulette I Free English Lessons I Thinkproject Academy I Social Events I Volunteering Activities I Open Forum with Leadership Team (Tp Café) I Hybrid working I Unlimited learning

We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.

Your Contact

Gagandeep Virdi

## About the job

Hey there\!

We’re [Fever](https://feverup.com/), the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors\! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment\!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About The Role

What you’ll do

* Own end-to-end product execution  
* Lead design from discovery to delivery within your squad.  
* Turn unclear problems into structured flows and testable solutions.  
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to balance speed and long-term scalability.  
* Balance speed with long-term product quality.  
* Raise the quality bar within the squad and the Product Design team  
* Bring structure to problem framing.  
* Clarify problem statements before jumping to UI.  
* Contribute to stronger discovery and validation practices  
* Push for measurable outcomes and clear success metrics.  
* Improve requirement quality and reduce rework.  
* Elevate critique and design discussions.  
* Design with systems in mind  
* Design with reusable components and scalable patterns.  
* Reduce inconsistencies and UX debt across squads.  
* Collaborate with engineers to ensure system integrity.  
* Propose improvements to components, documentation, and usage standards.  
* Improve quality and speed  
* Identify pragmatic opportunities where AI capabilities can improve user experience.  
* Know when to use each tool to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, prototyping, documentation, and iteration.  
* Apply structured prompting to enhance output efficiency  
* Critically assess AI-generated outputs rather than accepting them at face value.

About You

* Proven ability to ship complex flows under time pressure.  
* Strong systems thinking and comfort with scalable patterns.  
* Experience contributing to or evolving a design system.  
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments.

Demonstrating how your design workflow is evolving with AI tooling adoption

Perks & Benefits

* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.  
* Stock options.  
* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader  
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences  
* Home office friendly  
* Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth  
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with\!  
* Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.  
* English Lessons  
* Gympass Membership  
* Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you\!

## About the job

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Emerging Products Design Team

Emerging Products is an org pillar inside Auth0. We figure out what's next. You'll be designing systems that help developers secure AI agents, manage granular permissions, and build on identity primitives that don't fully exist yet.

Engineers, PMs, and Designers work on the same problems at the same time. There is no design-then-build sequence. There's just build.

What you’ll be doing

When everyone on the team can generate UI, the designer's role shifts. You become the person responsible for taste, quality, experience, and customer voice. You hold the quality bar when speed is pushing everything toward "fine."

* Prototype at volume: Use AI tools and code to explore dozens of directions fast, then narrow based on what works and what solves the actual problem.  
* Design in the codebase: Work within our React and Next.js environment to refine components and interactions where users will actually experience them.  
* Simplify complexity: Turn authorization models, SDK patterns, and security flows into interfaces that feel clear without losing precision.  
* Raise the craft: Help the broader design org see what this way of working looks like in practice. We're all figuring this out together.

What you’ll bring to the role

* You have craft: This matters most. Considered typography, intentional spacing, polished micro-interactions, details that show someone genuinely cared. We're looking for someone with a refined sense of design taste/aesthetics and a deep appreciation for the details that create a polished user experience.  
* You build: 6+ years of design experience, but somewhere along the way you started prototyping in the browser, shipping side projects, or writing production code because you wanted the interaction exactly right.  
* You have a real AI practice: Not experimentation, but an actual workflow. You have opinions about where AI tools help and where they fall short.  
* You design for developers: Tools, APIs, CLIs, SDKs, and admin dashboards. You know "simple" means something different for this audience.

Note for when applying

In your application, please include a link to your portfolio with password (if protected). We prioritize a review of your design craft and any examples of your work in code.

  # **Product Designer UX/UI**

  En [**Redbility**](https://www.redbility.com/) buscamos un **UX/UI Product Designer** con al menos 2 años de experiencia que entienda que el diseño es la herramienta definitiva para resolver problemas de negocio complejos y convertirlos en experiencias digitales memorables. Estamos creciendo y buscamos personas que compartan nuestra pasión por la arquitectura de la información, el diseño , la tecnología y la consultoría UX; elementos que consideramos clave para el éxito de nuestros proyectos.  
  Somos parte del ecosistema [**Jungle**](https://www.wejungle.com/), consultora que transforma negocios desde un modelo integrado que conecta diseño, comunicación y tecnología para generar diferenciación y un impacto medible en el negocio de nuestros clientes. En Jungle acompañamos a las compañías desde la construcción de marca y la activación cultural hasta la experiencia digital, el desarrollo web y e-commerce y la medición, eliminando la fragmentación entre agencias creativas, consultoras y proveedores tecnológicos.  
  Con un equipo de más de 700 profesionales y como empresa certificada B Corp, mantenemos un compromiso firme con la innovación responsable.

  ### **¿Tu día a día?**

* **Investigación y estrategia UX:** Tu trabajo empieza escuchando y preguntando; serás experto en encontrar patrones clave en el comportamiento del usuario para transformar necesidades de negocio en arquitecturas de información sólidas y flujos lógicos.  
* **Excelencia visual y sistemas:** Diseñarás soluciones donde la sensibilidad visual y el rigor de los sistemas de diseño caminen de la mano, garantizando experiencias que no solo sean impecables, sino plenamente funcionales.  
* **Gestión y trato directo:** Presentarás tus proyectos con confianza ante clientes, coordinándote con ellos de manera clara y profesional, gestionando el feedback con maestría y asegurando que cada propuesta aporte valor real.

  ### **¿Cómo te imaginamos?**

* **Experiencia con criterio:** Al menos 2 años diseñando productos digitales de principio a fin, demostrando un dominio de la usabilidad, el diseño de interacción y la arquitectura de la información.  
* **Pasión por el research:** No te conformas con la superficie, tienes una curiosidad innata por investigar y validar tus decisiones de diseño mediante datos y patrones de comportamiento.  
* **Perfil híbrido y resolutivo:** Entiendes cómo "aterrizar" tus ideas gracias a tus conocimientos básicos de **c**ódigo y gestores de contenido (CMS).  
* **Dominio de herramientas de vanguardia:** Usuario avanzado de Figma y prototipado, con un flujo de trabajo ágil, ordenado y escalable.  
* **Curiosidad e innovación:** Interés constante por aprender, desde nuevas interacciones en IA hasta el crecimiento personal continuo que define nuestra cultura de excelencia.  
* **Espíritu Redbility:** Alguien con autonomía para decidir pero con una mentalidad profundamente colaborativa. Buscamos a una persona con actitud positiva, que contribuya al buen ambiente y trabaje con compromiso.

  ### **Beneficios y cultura**

* **Flexibilidad remote-first:** Trabajo remoto con libertad de ubicación y acceso a nuestras oficinas en Madrid para fomentar la colaboración presencial cuando lo desees.  
* **Conciliación y horario 5.0:** Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida, jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año y horario especial de verano.  
* **Compensación inteligente:** Programa de retribución flexible abarcando servicios de seguro médico privado (DKV), transporte, restauración y guardería.  
* **Plan de carrera personalizado:** Itinerarios de crecimiento profesional diseñados para potenciar tu liderazgo y convertirte en un referente del sector.  
* **Proyectos de alto impacto:** Oportunidad de trabajar en retos estratégicos para marcas líderes en el mercado nacional e internacional como Inditex, Acciona, COPE y Telefónica entre otros.  
  Si te apasiona transformar la complejidad en elegancia y ver cómo tus ideas cobran vida, este es tu sitio.

  ### **¿Qué traerá el mañana?**

  Los próximos días revisaremos tu candidatura; sin ayuda de algoritmos ni máquinas, sino al estilo más humano. Si encajas con las necesidades de la vacante te contactaremos para agendar una entrevista virtual.

# **Senior Product Designer**

Apply for this job  
FitXR is building a love of movement in everyone. Forget products for people who already enjoy exercise. This is about fitness for the 96% of people who don’t go to the gym and who haven’t already built habits around fitness. Operating at the intersection of spatial and wearable AI, we build experiences that prove exercise can be genuinely fun and for everyone.

While nothing compares to trying it yourself, [this trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-lgizcjE2n0) gives you a taste.

With \> 100,000 users, we have product-market fit and are profitable with an exceptional team of \~35 people and a heavy innovation arc ahead of us.

Right now, our biggest unlock is compressing weeks of research, prototyping and validation into days. You'll be joining us on that journey and helping accelerate it.

This role is fully remote from the UK, East Coast US or Spain.

#### **What you’ll be doing 👀**

You’ll be using AI to power your workflow of research, prototype, validate, refine and ship.

* Research \- Get to know users better than anyone. Build tools that pull signal from a wide range of sources – reviews, communities, behavioural data – synthesise it fast and use it to stay laser-focused on the changes that actually help people build a fitness habit and hit their goals.  
* Prototype – Rapidly turn problems and opportunities from research into lo-fi prototypes. Using the right AI tooling, you'll go from insight to something testable incredibly quickly.  
* Validate – Engage with users fast and often. Pressure-test assumptions and get feedback on what’s actually landing before spending time polishing.  
* Refine – Turning a validated idea into something polished requires a strong design eye and it’s probably where AI helps least. Getting here faster and with more confidence will have an enormous impact.  
* Ship \- Work closely with engineering on the handover from prototype to production ready code and stay involved through launch and iteration.

#### **What we’re looking for ✅**

* You have exceptionally strong design taste  
* You've used AI to collapse the time between user insight and validated prototype  
* You’re keen to push the boundaries between design and engineering, shipping yourself wherever possible and experimenting with Cursor, Claude Code or similar  
* You care about the details but you don't let them slow you down \- fast when it needs to be fast, polished when it needs to be polished  
* You have strong opinions and aren’t shy advocating for users but you know the goal is to move things forward together, not to win the argument  
* You’ve delivered in fully remote teams and thrive with collaborative, async work

#### **Maybe skip this if ❌**

* You’re using AI as a thinking partner to refine your ideas but haven’t really overhauled the way you work  
  You design purely on instinct or validate only on release with users  
* You thrive in well-defined roles with clear handoffs and structured processes

#### **Benefits 🤙**

🌎 Fully remote from the UK, US (East Coast) or Spain  
🏝 Unlimited paid annual leave policy  
⏰ Flexible 40-hour working week (core hours 10am–4:30pm)  
🌱 £1,000 / $1000 / €1000 per annum learning budget  
🧘 £750 / $750 / €750 per annum wellness budget  
🏡 £500 / $500 / €500 home office setup budget  
❤️‍🩹Health cover, dental and vision via Aetna in the US and Vitality in the UK  
💸401k on a tiered match system up to 3.5% in the US  
🪐 A Meta Quest to get you immersed in FitXR and the wider VR ecosystem  
✈️ Work from anywhere scheme to combine work and travel  
👶 12 weeks fully-paid family leave from day one, regardless of gender or sexual identity

## **About FitXR**

FitXR is a fitness technology company working at the cutting edge of VR and MR, building a movement for movement.

We started life in 2016 in a garden shed in the UK. Today, we’re building FitXR, one of the top-downloaded apps on the Meta Quest store. We’ve raised close to $30m from top investors such as Maveron, Hiro, and BoostVC.

We've built a growing range of fitness studios, from box workouts with world-class trainers like Olympian Nicola Adams to immersive Zumba dance classes. While nothing compares to trying it yourself, you can watch a [trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-lgizcjE2n0).

Our team is distributed across Europe and the US. We’re guided by our Principles of Play: four core beliefs about how we treat each other and our community. We make space for every voice, believe in the importance of a learner’s mindset, and prioritize team success over individual glory.

FitXR is available on Meta Quest 2 & 3 and has been downloaded by over a million people worldwide and featured in Forbes, Empire, T3, Washington Post, Men's Health, GQ and more.

FitXR have been rated one of the top 10 Most Promising Startups, \#2 in Flexa's most flexible VR startups and \#28 in Tempo's top 100 super startups to work for 🎉

## About the job

En Iris, no solo creamos compañías; forjamos líderes en innovación tecnológica. Nos mueve la ambición, la excelencia y la empatía para redefinir el futuro de nuestros clientes a través de tecnología avanzada (Cloud, Ciberseguridad, Data, IA).

Precisamente de esta visión y dentro de nuestro ecosistema nace Velorum: el sistema nervioso digital de la empresa.

Se conecta de forma automática a todos los sistemas —aplicaciones, bases de datos, infraestructura— y construye un mapa vivo de cómo funciona realmente la organización por dentro: qué existe, cómo se relaciona todo, y qué impacto tiene cada cambio. Todo ello sin entrevistar a nadie, sin documentar manualmente, y sin que la información salga de la red.

El resultado es una empresa que se conoce a sí misma. Que puede responder en minutos preguntas que antes costaban semanas. Que toma decisiones con visibilidad completa. Y que no depende del conocimiento de unas pocas personas para seguir funcionando cuando algo cambia.

Para seguir escalando esta visión, buscamos un/a UX/UI Designer que se una al equipo de Producto & Desarrollo para liderar la experiencia de usuario de Velorum. Serás la persona responsable de traducir conceptos técnicos complejos —grafos de conocimiento, mapas de dependencias, flujos de metadatos empresariales— en interfaces claras, funcionales y estéticamente coherentes. Trabajarás transversalmente con product managers y equipos de desarrollo, participando desde el discovery hasta la entrega final.

Desafíos Del Rol

Diseño de producto

– Definir y mantener el sistema de diseño de Velorum (componentes, tokens, guías de estilo) en Figma.

– Diseñar flujos, wireframes y prototipos de alta fidelidad para nuevas funcionalidades.

– Liderar el diseño de distintas aplicaciones.

– Asegurar coherencia visual y funcional entre módulos del producto.

Research & discovery

– Realizar entrevistas con usuarios para identificar necesidades y validar hipótesis.

– Participar en sesiones de refinamiento y planificación de sprints aportando perspectiva de experiencia de usuario.

– Proponer y ejecutar pruebas de usabilidad iterativas sobre prototipos y producto en producción.

Colaboración y entrega

– Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para garantizar la viabilidad técnica del diseño.

– Preparar especificaciones de handoff (Figma Dev Mode, redlines, documentación de interacción).

Requisitos mínimos

– 3+ años de experiencia en diseño UX/UI de productos digitales, preferiblemente SaaS B2B o herramientas enterprise.

– Dominio avanzado de Figma (componentes, auto-layout, variables, prototipos interactivos, Dev Mode).

– Experiencia en diseño de interfaces de datos complejos: dashboards, grafos, árboles de dependencias, visualizaciones.

– Capacidad para trabajar con Design Systems propios y contribuir a su evolución.

– Pensamiento sistémico: capacidad de estructurar problemas de UX en productos de alta complejidad técnica.

– Comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.

– Autonomía y criterio: capaz de tomar decisiones de diseño con información parcial.

– Orientación a la iteración: cultura de feedback continuo y mejora incremental.

– Atención al detalle sin perder la visión del conjunto.

## About the job

WeTransfer helps millions of users share ideas and collaborate seamlessly. Now part of Bending Spoons, it plays a key role in a portfolio of outstanding digital businesses united by a shared focus on innovation and operational excellence. By applying through the WeTransfer brand, you’ll be stepping into the wider Bending Spoons team. You may work directly on WeTransfer or contribute to one of our other leading products. Either way, you’ll be part of a high-performing, collaborative environment where you can make a real impact.

At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

To achieve this objective, we execute the following strategy: We acquire a digital business with untapped potential and make it as successful as we can by leveraging our platform—which comprises our expertise, technologies, data, brand, talents, and company culture. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we operate so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities

* Shape high-leverage product experiences. Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful.  
* Start with an LLM. Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction.  
* Prototype and build with AI. Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result.  
* Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one. Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions.  
* Validate and measure. Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next.  
* Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog. Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver.

What we look for

* Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.  
* Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.  
* Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.  
* Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer

* Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.  
* An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.  
* Competitive pay and access to equity in the company. Typically, we offer individuals at the start of their career an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.  
* All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, [a rich relocation package](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbendingspoons%2Ecom%2Fdocuments%2FCulture%2520%26%2520Policies%25E2%2580%2594Travel%2520%26%2520Relocation%25E2%2580%2594Company%2520Website%2Epdf&urlhash=M4Vn&isSdui=true), generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.

Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.

Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland) or remote in selected countries.

The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through [this form](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbndspn%2Ecom%2Fjob-accommodation-request-form&urlhash=pvg-&isSdui=true).

Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we recommend spending your first few months working from our Milan office, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from our offices in Milan or London, or remotely from [approved countries](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fjobs%2Ebendingspoons%2Ecom%2Ffaq%23Relocation%2520and%2520remote%2520work&urlhash=ZhNC&isSdui=true)—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

## About the job

The UI/UX Designer is responsible for creating intuitive and consistent digital experiences across products and web platforms. This role collaborates with product, development, and marketing teams to deliver user-centered solutions from research to final design handoff.

Responsibilities

* Design wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes  
* Create and optimize user flows and journeys  
* Maintain and evolve design systems  
* Collaborate with product, development, and marketing teams  
* Prepare assets and documentation for developer handoff  
* Conduct light UX research to validate design decisions  
* Improve existing digital experiences  
* Manage tasks using ticket management tools  
* Apply UI/UX best practices in design solutions  
* Participate in design reviews and team discussions  
* Ensure visual consistency across product and web

Requirements

* Experience as a UI/UX Designer or Product Designer  
* Updated portfolio with digital design projects  
* Strong knowledge of design tools  
* Experience creating wireframes and prototypes  
* Experience working with design systems  
* Understanding of user-centered design processes  
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams

Nice to Have

* Experience working on digital products  
* UX research experience  
* Experience preparing developer handoffs  
* Familiarity with task management tools  
* Basic understanding of development workflows  
* Experience improving user journeys

Soft Skills

* Critical thinking  
* Clear communication  
* Organization and autonomy  
* Attention to detail  
* Creativity  
* Teamwork  
* Time management  
* User-focused mindset  
* By applying to this position, we’ll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

About the job

At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.

We are looking for a product designer to work on Air, the company's new agentic development environment. Air is a new kind of developer tool: a workspace where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. The product includes a native desktop app and a web-based experience, with cloud execution and collaborative workflows in the works. AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, and our goal is to design an environment that makes this shift feel natural, for both solo developers and entire engineering teams.

We’re looking for someone who can lead design initiatives, own key product areas, and bring clarity and usability to complex technical workflows. Design plays a critical role in these products by helping developers stay in flow, reduce their cognitive load, and work more confidently across tools.

In This Role, You Will

Design and deliver high-quality user interfaces by creating wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.

Lead large-scale initiatives from vision and strategy to execution.

Collaborate with product managers, developers, and researchers to define problems, align on goals, and ensure design solutions meet user and business needs.

Communicate design concepts and decisions to the team to promote alignment and comprehension.

Collaborate with the UX Research and Analytics team to validate ideas and create design solutions grounded in real user needs and behavioral data.

Work closely with the development team to implement and review your UI/UX solutions.

Improve design processes together with the UX team, helping with the development of our design system to maintain visual and functional consistency across the product while enabling flexibility and scale.

We will be happy to have you on our team if you have:

At least 5 years of experience in UI/UX design.

Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where the product, technology, and priorities evolve quickly.

Experience designing complex functional interfaces. 

A willingness to dive into complex topics related to programming.

The ability to prototype, verify, present, and provide reasoning for your UI/UX solutions.

Diligence and attention to detail.

Spoken and written English at a level sufficient for everyday communication and writing documentation.

Proactivity, independence, and strong time-management skills.

The ability to work in a team and seek feedback to improve your solutions and processes.

We Would Be Especially Thrilled If You Have Experience

Designing for developer-focused products or technical environments.

Designing complex functional interfaces.

Programming and working with AI.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

🕵🏽 ¿Qué buscamos? 🕵🏽

* Más de 2/3 años de experiencia en UX/UI Design, Product Design o roles similares dentro de entornos digitales.  
* Portfolio sólido que demuestre experiencia en el diseño de productos digitales, incluyendo procesos de diseño y resultados obtenidos.  
* Experiencia en el diseño de interfaces y experiencias para aplicaciones web y mobile, aplicando principios de diseño centrado en el usuario.  
* Dominio de herramientas de diseño y prototipado como Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD o equivalentes.  
* Experiencia en la creación, implementación y mantenimiento de design systems y bibliotecas de componentes.  
* Conocimiento práctico de metodologías de investigación de usuarios, pruebas de usabilidad y prototipado.  
* Experiencia trabajando en entornos ágiles (Scrum, Kanban) y en colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares de producto y desarrollo.

💡Valoramos experiencia en productos digitales complejos, sensibilidad por performance, accesibilidad y calidad de código.  
¡¡Y lo más importante de todo que realmente estés motivadx para un cambio\!\!  
🚀 ¿Qué ofrecemos? 🚀  
Podemos asegurarte que contamos con el mejor equipo de todo el sector. Desde el proceso de selección, tu incorporación y hasta nuestro desarrollo profesional te ofrecemos un acompañamiento y un seguimiento personalizado en todo momento. Y a todo esto súmale transparencia total en todos los pasos.  
Pinta bien, ¿verdad?  
📝 Condiciones 📝  
Tenemos la seguridad de que ya sabes qué es lo que muchas empresas te ofrecen y por supuesto estamos a la altura:

* Tendrás acceso a formación continua para que puedas estar al día.  
* Podrás participar en proyectos nacionales e internacionales con opción a movilidad.  
* No todo va a ser trabajar, por eso disfrutar de la tarjeta restaurante y seguro médico nos parece esencial.  
* ¡¡¡Teambuildings, afterworks y muchas más sorpresas\!\!\!
